neighbors to a center point.\nfunc (si *SpatialIndex) KNN(center Coordinate, k int, startTime, endTime time.Time) []GeoPoint {\n\tsi.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer si.mu.RUnlock()\n\n\ttype distPoint struct {\n\t\tpoint GeoPoint\n\t\tdist  float64\n\t}\n\n\tvar candidates []distPoint\n\tfor _, p := range si.points {\n\t\tif !startTime.IsZero() && p.Timestamp.Before(startTime) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !endTime.IsZero() && p.Timestamp.After(endTime) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tdist := haversine(center, p.Coord)\n\t\tcandidates = append(candidates, distPoint{p, dist})\n\t}\n\n\tsort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\treturn candidates[i].dist < candidates[j].dist\n\t})\n\n\tif k > len(candidates) {\n\t\tk = len(candidates)\n\t}\n\n\tresult := make([]GeoPoint, k)\n\tfor i := 0; i < k; i++ {\n\t\tresult[i] = candidates[i].point\n\t}\n\treturn result\n}\n\n// GridStats returns cell statistics at a given resolution level.\nfunc (si *SpatialIndex) GridStats(level int) []GridCell {\n\tsi.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer si.mu.RUnlock()\n\n\tcells := make(map[string]*GridCell)\n\tfor _, p := range si.points {\n\t\tx, y, key := gridKey(p.Coord, level)\n\t\tif _, ok := cells[key]; !ok {\n\t\t\tcells[key] = &GridCell{Level: level, X: x, Y: y}\n\t\t}\n\t\tcells[key].Count++\n\t\tcells[key].Points = append(cells[key].Points, p)\n\t}\n\n\tresult := make([]GridCell, 0, len(cells))\n\tfor _, c := range cells {\n\t\tresult = append(result, *c)\n\t}\n\treturn result\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 2. HEATMAP GENERATOR\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n// HeatmapCell represents a single cell in a heatmap.\ntype HeatmapCell struct {\n\tX      int     `json:\"x\"`\n\tY      int     `json:\"y\"`\n\tLat    float64 `json:\"lat\"`\n\tLng    float64 `json:\"lng\"`\n\tIntensity float64 `json:\"intensity\"` // 0-1 normalized\n\tCount  int     `json:\"count\"`\n}\n\n// HeatmapConfig configures heatmap generation.\ntype HeatmapConfig struct {\n\tLevel      int     `json:\"level\"`       // Grid resolution (0-15)\n\tRadius     float64 `json:\"radius\"`       // Kernel radius in cells\n\tBlur       float64 `json:\"blur\"`         // Gaussian blur sigma\n\tMinWeight  float64 `json:\"min_weight\"`   // Minimum weight to include\n\tSource     string  `json:\"source,omitempty\"` // Filter by source\n\tTimeWindow time.Duration `json:\"time_window\"` // Time window\n}\n\nfunc DefaultHeatmapConfig() HeatmapConfig {\n\treturn HeatmapConfig{\n\t\tLevel:      8,    // ~0.7° cells\n\t\tRadius:     3,    // 3-cell kernel\n\t\tBlur:       1.5,  // Gaussian sigma\n\t\tMinWeight:  0.01, // 1% minimum\n\t\tTimeWindow: 24 * time.Hour,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Heatmap generates a 2D heatmap from indexed points.\nfunc (si *SpatialIndex) Heatmap(config HeatmapConfig) []HeatmapCell {\n\tsi.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer si.mu.RUnlock()\n\n\t// Build raw grid\n\tgrid := make(map[string]*HeatmapCell)\n\tcutoff := time.Now().Add(-config.TimeWindow)\n\n\tfor _, p := range si.points {\n\t\tif config.Source != \"\" && p.Source != config.Source {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif p.Timestamp.Before(cutoff) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tx, y, key := gridKey(p.Coord, config.Level)\n\t\tif _, ok := grid[key]; !ok {\n\t\t\tres := 180.0 / float64(1<<config.Level)\n\t\t\tgrid[key] = &HeatmapCell{\n\t\t\t\tX: x, Y: y,\n\t\t\t\tLat: float64(y)*res - 90 + res/2,\n\t\t\t\tLng: float64(x)*res - 180 + res/2,\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tgrid[key].Count++\n\t}\n\n\t// Apply Gaussian kernel for smoothing\n\tcells := make([]HeatmapCell, 0, len(grid))\n\tmaxIntensity := 0.0\n\n\tfor _, cell := range grid {\n\t\tintensity := float64(cell.Count)\n\n\t\t// Apply blur from neighboring cells\n\t\tif config.Blur > 0 {\n\t\t\tfor _, other := range grid {\n\t\t\t\tdx := float64(cell.X - other.X)\n\t\t\t\tdy := float64(cell.Y - other.Y)\n\t\t\t\tdist := math.Sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)\n\t\t\t\tif dist <= config.Radius && dist > 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tweight := gaussianWeight(dist, config.Blur)\n\t\t\t\t\tintensity += float64(other.Count) * weight\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcell.Intensity = intensity\n\t\tif intensity > maxIntensity {\n\t\t\tmaxIntensity = intensity\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Normalize\n\tfor _, cell := range grid {\n\t\tif maxIntensity > 0 {\n\t\t\tcell.Intensity /= maxIntensity\n\t\t}\n\t\tif cell.Intensity >= config.MinWeight {\n\t\t\tcells = append(cells, *cell)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tsort.Slice(cells, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\treturn cells[i].Intensity > cells[j].Intensity\n\t})\n\n\treturn cells\n}\n\nfunc gaussianWeight(dist, sigma float64) float64 {\n\treturn math.Exp(-(dist*dist)/(2*sigma*sigma)) / (sigma * math.Sqrt(2*math.Pi))\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 3. GEO-EVENT CORRELATION SYSTEM\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n// GeoCluster represents a correlated group of geospatial events.\ntype GeoCluster struct {\n\tID        string      `json:\"id\"`\n\tCenter    Coordinate  `json:\"center\"`\n\tRadius    float64     `json:\"radius\"`    // km\n\tCount     int         `json:\"count\"`\n\tDuration  float64     `json:\"duration\"`  // minutes\n\tStartTime time.Time   `json:\"start_time\"`\n\tEndTime   time.Time   `json:\"end_time\"`\n\tScore     float64     `json:\"score\"`     // correlation score 0-100\n\tSources   []string    `json:\"sources\"`\n\tPoints    []GeoPoint  `json:\"points\"`\n\tLabel     string      `json:\"label,omitempty\"` // auto-assigned\n}\n\n// CorrelationConfig controls the correlation algorithm.\ntype CorrelationConfig struct {\n\tMaxRadiusKm    float64       `json:\"max_radius_km\"`\n\tMaxTimeDiff    time.Duration `json:\"max_time_diff\"`\n\tMinPoints      int           `json:\"min_points\"`\n\tMinSources     int           `json:\"min_sources\"`\n\tSpatialWeight  float64       `json:\"spatial_weight\"`  // 0-1\n\tTemporalWeight float64       `json:\"temporal_weight\"` // 0-1\n\tSourceWeight   float64       `json:\"source_weight\"`   // 0-1\n}\n\nfunc DefaultCorrelationConfig() CorrelationConfig {\n\treturn CorrelationConfig{\n\t\tMaxRadiusKm:    50.0,         // 50km\n\t\tMaxTimeDiff:    6 * time.Hour, // 6h window\n\t\tMinPoints:      3,            // min 3 points\n\t\tMinSources:     1,            // min 1 source\n\t\tSpatialWeight:  0.4,\n\t\tTemporalWeight: 0.3,\n\t\tSourceWeight:   0.3,\n\t}\n}\n\n// CorrelateEvents finds correlated geospatial events.\n// Uses spatio-temporal clustering (DBSCAN-like approach).\nfunc (si *SpatialIndex) CorrelateEvents(config CorrelationConfig) []GeoCluster {\n\tsi.mu.RLock()\n\tpoints := make([]GeoPoint, len(si.points))\n\tcopy(points, si.points)\n\tsi.mu.RUnlock()\n\n\tif len(points) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tsort.Slice(points, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\treturn points[i].Timestamp.Before(points[j].Timestamp)\n\t})\n\n\t// DBSCAN-like clustering\n\tvisited := make(map[int]bool)\n\tvar clusters []GeoCluster\n\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(points); i++ {\n\t\tif visited[i] {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tvisited[i] = true\n\n\t\t// Find neighbors\n\t\tcluster := GeoCluster{\n\t\t\tCenter:    points[i].Coord,\n\t\t\tStartTime: points[i].Timestamp,\n\t\t\tEndTime:   points[i].Timestamp,\n\t\t\tSources:   []string{points[i].Source},\n\t\t\tPoints:    []GeoPoint{points[i]},\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcluster = expandCluster(points, i, visited, cluster, config)\n\t\tsourceSet := make(map[string]bool)\n\t\tfor _, s := range cluster.Sources {\n\t\t\tsourceSet[s] = true\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif len(cluster.Points) >= config.MinPoints &&\n\t\t\tlen(sourceSet) >= config.MinSources {\n\t\t\tcluster.Count = len(cluster.Points)\n\t\t\tcluster.Duration = cluster.EndTime.Sub(cluster.StartTime).Minutes()\n\t\t\tcluster.Score = computeCorrelationScore(cluster, config)\n\t\t\tcluster.Label = assignClusterLabel(cluster)\n\t\t\tclusters = append(clusters, cluster)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tsort.Slice(clusters, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\treturn clusters[i].Score > clusters[j].Score\n\t})\n\n\treturn clusters\n}\n\nfunc expandCluster(points []GeoPoint, seedIdx int, visited map[int]bool, cluster GeoCluster, config CorrelationConfig) GeoCluster {\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(points); i++ {\n\t\tif visited[i] {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tdist := haversine(cluster.Center, points[i].Coord)\n\t\ttimeDiff := points[i].Timestamp.Sub(cluster.StartTime)\n\t\tif timeDiff < 0 {\n\t\t\ttimeDiff = -timeDiff\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif dist <= config.MaxRadiusKm && timeDiff <= config.MaxTimeDiff {\n\t\t\tvisited[i] = true\n\t\t\tcluster.Points = append(cluster.Points, points[i])\n\n\t\t\t// Update center (centroid)\n\t\t\tvar sumLat, sumLng float64\n\t\t\tfor _, p := range cluster.Points {\n\t\t\t\tsumLat += p.Coord.Lat\n\t\t\t\tsumLng += p.Coord.Lng\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tn := float64(len(cluster.Points))\n\t\t\tcluster.Center = Coordinate{Lat: sumLat / n, Lng: sumLng / n}\n\n\t\t\t// Update time bounds\n\t\t\tif points[i].Timestamp.Before(cluster.StartTime) {\n\t\t\t\tcluster.StartTime = points[i].Timestamp\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif points[i].Timestamp.After(cluster.EndTime) {\n\t\t\t\tcluster.EndTime = points[i].Timestamp\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Add source\n\t\t\tfound := false\n\t\t\tfor _, s := range cluster.Sources {\n\t\t\t\tif s == points[i].Source {\n\t\t\t\t\tfound = true\n\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif !found {\n\t\t\t\tcluster.Sources = append(cluster.Sources, points[i].Source)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tcluster = expandCluster(points, i, visited, cluster, config)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn cluster\n}\n\nfunc computeCorrelationScore(cluster GeoCluster, config CorrelationConfig) float64 {\n\t// Spatial density: more points in smaller area = higher score\n\tspatialScore := 0.0\n\tif cluster.Radius > 0 {\n\t\tspatialScore = math.Min(1.0, float64(cluster.Count)/100.0) *\n\t\t\t(1 - math.Min(1.0, cluster.Radius/config.MaxRadiusKm))\n\t} else {\n\t\tspatialScore = math.Min(1.0, float64(cluster.Count)/100.0)\n\t}\n\n\t// Temporal concentration\n\ttemporalScore := 0.5\n\tif cluster.Duration > 0 {\n\t\tmaxDuration := config.MaxTimeDiff.Minutes()\n\t\ttemporalScore = 1 - math.Min(1.0, cluster.Duration/maxDuration)\n\t}\n\n\t// Source diversity\n\tsourceScore := math.Min(1.0, float64(len(cluster.Sources))/5.0)\n\n\tscore := (spatialScore*config.SpatialWeight +\n\t\ttemporalScore*config.TemporalWeight +\n\t\tsourceScore*config.SourceWeight) * 100\n\n\treturn math.Max(0, math.Min(100, score))\n}\n\nfunc assignClusterLabel(cluster GeoCluster) string {\n\tswitch {\n\tcase cluster.Count > 50 && cluster.Duration < 60:\n\t\treturn \"mass_event\"\n\tcase cluster.Count > 20 && len(cluster.Sources) > 2:\n\t\treturn \"multi_source_activity\"\n\tcase cluster.Duration > 720:\n\t\treturn \"prolonged_activity\"\n\tcase cluster.Radius < 1:\n\t\treturn \"concentrated_point\"\n\tcase len(cluster.Sources) == 1:\n\t\treturn \"single_source_pattern\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn \"geo_correlation\"\n\t}\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 4. MOVEMENT TRACKING MODEL\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n// Trajectory represents a movement path over time.\ntype Trajectory struct {\n\tID          string      `json:\"id\"`\n\tSourceID    string      `json:\"source_id\"`\n\tPoints      []GeoPoint  `json:\"points\"`\n\tStartTime   time.Time   `json:\"start_time\"`\n\tEndTime     time.Time   `json:\"end_time\"`\n\tDistanceKm  float64     `json:\"distance_km\"`\n\tAvgSpeedKph float64     `json:\"avg_speed_kph\"`\n\tBearing     float64     `json:\"bearing\"`     // degrees from north\n\tStatus      string      `json:\"status\"`       // stationary | moving | maneuvering\n}\n\n// MovementPattern describes a detected movement pattern.\ntype MovementPattern struct {\n\tType        string      `json:\"type\"`         // loitering | transit | rendezvous | avoidance\n\tSourceIDs   []string    `json:\"source_ids\"`\n\tLocation    Coordinate  `json:\"location\"`\n\tRadius      float64     `json:\"radius\"`        // km\n\tStartTime   time.Time   `json:\"start_time\"`\n\tEndTime     time.Time   `json:\"end_time\"`\n\tConfidence  float64     `json:\"confidence\"`\n}\n\n// MovementTracker analyzes movement patterns from sequential points.\ntype MovementTracker struct {\n\tmu         sync.RWMutex\n\ttrajectories map[string]*Trajectory // sourceID → trajectory\n\tpatterns   []MovementPattern\n\tmaxHistory int\n}\n\nfunc NewMovementTracker(maxHistory int) *MovementTracker {\n\treturn &MovementTracker{\n\t\ttrajectories: make(map[string]*Trajectory),\n\t\tpatterns:     make([]MovementPattern, 0),\n\t\tmaxHistory:   maxHistory,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Update adds a point to a trajectory, creating or extending it.\nfunc (mt *MovementTracker) Update(point GeoPoint) *Trajectory {\n\tmt.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer mt.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tsourceID := point.Source\n\tif sourceID == \"\" {\n\t\tsourceID = point.ID\n\t}\n\n\ttraj, exists := mt.trajectories[sourceID]\n\tif !exists {\n\t\ttraj = &Trajectory{\n\t\t\tID:        fmt.Sprintf(\"traj-%s\", sourceID),\n\t\t\tSourceID:  sourceID,\n\t\t\tPoints:    make([]GeoPoint, 0),\n\t\t\tStartTime: point.Timestamp,\n\t\t}\n\t\tmt.trajectories[sourceID] = traj\n\t}\n\n\ttraj.Points = append(traj.Points, point)\n\ttraj.EndTime = point.Timestamp\n\n\t// Compute trajectory metrics\n\tif len(traj.Points) >= 2 {\n\t\tlast := traj.Points[len(traj.Points)-2]\n\t\tdist := haversine(last.Coord, point.Coord)\n\t\ttraj.DistanceKm += dist\n\n\t\ttimeDiff := point.Timestamp.Sub(last.Timestamp).Hours()\n\t\tif timeDiff > 0 {\n\t\t\tspeed := dist / timeDiff\n\t\t\t// Weighted average speed\n\t\t\tif traj.AvgSpeedKph == 0 {\n\t\t\t\ttraj.AvgSpeedKph = speed\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\ttraj.AvgSpeedKph = (traj.AvgSpeedKph*0.7 + speed*0.3)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Bearing (approximate)\n\t\ttraj.Bearing = computeBearing(last.Coord, point.Coord)\n\n\t\t// Status classification\n\t\tswitch {\n\t\tcase traj.AvgSpeedKph < 1:\n\t\t\ttraj.Status = \"stationary\"\n\t\tcase traj.AvgSpeedKph < 10:\n\t\t\ttraj.Status = \"maneuvering\"\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\ttraj.Status = \"moving\"\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Limit points per trajectory\n\tif len(traj.Points) > mt.maxHistory {\n\t\ttraj.Points = traj.Points[len(traj.Points)-mt.maxHistory:]\n\t}\n\n\treturn traj\n}\n\n// DetectPatterns finds movement patterns across all trajectories.\nfunc (mt *MovementTracker) DetectPatterns(minPoints int) []MovementPattern {\n\tmt.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer mt.mu.RUnlock()\n\n\tvar patterns []MovementPattern\n\n\tfor sourceID, traj := range mt.trajectories {\n\t\tif len(traj.Points) < minPoints {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Loitering detection: stationary within small radius for extended time\n\t\tif traj.Status == \"stationary\" && traj.DistanceKm < 0.5 {\n\t\t\tduration := traj.EndTime.Sub(traj.StartTime)\n\t\t\tif duration > 10*time.Minute {\n\t\t\t\tpatterns = append(patterns, MovementPattern{\n\t\t\t\t\tType: \"loitering\",\n\t\t\t\t\tSourceIDs: []string{sourceID},\n\t\t\t\t\tLocation: traj.Points[len(traj.Points)-1].Coord,\n\t\t\t\t\tRadius: traj.DistanceKm,\n\t\t\t\t\tStartTime: traj.StartTime,\n\t\t\t\t\tEndTime: traj.EndTime,\n\t\t\t\t\tConfidence: math.Min(1.0, duration.Minutes()/60.0),\n\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Transit detection: high speed, long distance, consistent bearing\n\t\tif traj.AvgSpeedKph > 20 && traj.DistanceKm > 10 {\n\t\t\tpatterns = append(patterns, MovementPattern{\n\t\t\t\tType: \"transit\",\n\t\t\t\tSourceIDs: []string{sourceID},\n\t\t\t\tLocation: traj.Points[0].Coord,\n\t\t\t\tStartTime: traj.StartTime,\n\t\t\t\tEndTime: traj.EndTime,\n\t\t\t\tConfidence: math.Min(1.0, traj.AvgSpeedKph/100.0),\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Rendezvous detection: two trajectories converging\n\tsources := make([]string, 0, len(mt.trajectories))\n\tfor id := range mt.trajectories {\n\t\tsources = append(sources, id)\n\t}\n\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(sources); i++ {\n\t\tfor j := i + 1; j < len(sources); j++ {\n\t\t\tt1 := mt.trajectories[sources[i]]\n\t\t\tt2 := mt.trajectories[sources[j]]\n\t\t\tif len(t1.Points) < 2 || len(t2.Points) < 2 {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Check if they end up close together\n\t\t\tp1 := t1.Points[len(t1.Points)-1]\n\t\t\tp2 := t2.Points[len(t2.Points)-1]\n\t\t\tdist := haversine(p1.Coord, p2.Coord)\n\n\t\t\t// Check if they started far apart\n\t\t\ts1 := t1.Points[0]\n\t\t\ts2 := t2.Points[0]\n\t\t\tstartDist := haversine(s1.Coord, s2.Coord)\n\n\t\t\tif dist < 1.0 && startDist > 5.0 {\n\t\t\t\ttimeDiff := p2.Timestamp.Sub(p1.Timestamp)\n\t\t\t\tif timeDiff < 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\ttimeDiff = -timeDiff\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tif timeDiff < 30*time.Minute {\n\t\t\t\t\tpatterns = append(patterns, MovementPattern{\n\t\t\t\t\t\tType: \"rendezvous\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tSourceIDs: []string{sources[i], sources[j]},\n\t\t\t\t\t\tLocation: p1.Coord,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tRadius: dist,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tStartTime: p1.Timestamp,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tEndTime: p2.Timestamp,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tConfidence: 0.8,\n\t\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn patterns\n}\n\n// GetTrajectory returns the trajectory for a source.\nfunc (mt *MovementTracker) GetTrajectory(sourceID string) *Trajectory {\n\tmt.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer mt.mu.RUnlock()\n\treturn mt.trajectories[sourceID]\n}\n\n// PredictPosition predicts the next position of a moving source.\nfunc (mt *MovementTracker) PredictPosition(sourceID string, ahead time.Duration) *Coordinate {\n\tmt.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer mt.mu.RUnlock()\n\n\ttraj, ok := mt.trajectories[sourceID]\n\tif !ok || len(traj.Points) < 2 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tlast := traj.Points[len(traj.Points)-1]\n\tprev := traj.Points[len(traj.Points)-2]\n\n\t// Speed vector\n\tspeedKph := traj.AvgSpeedKph\n\tbearing := traj.Bearing\n\n\tif speedKph == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\t// Predict position: distance = speed × time\n\thours := ahead.Hours()\n\tdistKm := speedKph * hours\n\n\tpredicted := destinationPoint(last.Coord, bearing, distKm)\n\treturn &predicted\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// GEOINT Engine — Integration point\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n// GEOINTEngine combines all geospatial capabilities.\ntype GEOINTEngine struct {\n\tSpatialIndex    *SpatialIndex\n\tMovementTracker *MovementTracker\n\tCorrelationConfig CorrelationConfig\n}\n\nfunc NewGEOINTEngine(maxPoints int) *GEOINTEngine {\n\treturn &GEOINTEngine{\n\t\tSpatialIndex:    NewSpatialIndex(maxPoints),\n\t\tMovementTracker: NewMovementTracker(100),\n\t\tCorrelationConfig: DefaultCorrelationConfig(),\n\t}\n}\n\n// Ingest adds a point to all subsystems.\nfunc (ge *GEOINTEngine) Ingest(point GeoPoint) {\n\tge.SpatialIndex.Insert(point)\n\tge.MovementTracker.Update(point)\n}\n\n// Analyze runs full geospatial analysis on indexed data.\nfunc (ge *GEOINTEngine) Analyze() map[string]interface{} {\n\tclusters := ge.SpatialIndex.CorrelateEvents(ge.CorrelationConfig)\n\theatmap := ge.SpatialIndex.Heatmap(DefaultHeatmapConfig())\n\tpatterns := ge.MovementTracker.DetectPatterns(3)\n\n\treturn map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\"total_points\": len(ge.SpatialIndex.points),\n\t\t\"clusters\":     clusters,\n\t\t\"heatmap\":      heatmap,\n\t\t\"patterns\":     patterns,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// Spatial Utilities (Haversine, Bearing, Destination)\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n// haversine computes the great-circle distance in km between two coordinates.\nfunc haversine(a, b Coordinate) float64 {\n\tconst R = 6371.0 // Earth radius in km\n\tdLat := (b.Lat - a.Lat) * math.Pi / 180\n\tdLng := (b.Lng - a.Lng) * math.Pi / 180\n\tlat1 := a.Lat * math.Pi / 180\n\tlat2 := b.Lat * math.Pi / 180\n\n\ts1 := math.Sin(dLat / 2)\n\ts2 := math.Sin(dLng / 2)\n\taVal := s1*s1 + ## ✅ Osiris GEOINT Engine — Geospatial Intelligence Layer

### 4 composants — 873 lignes, 0 dépendances externes

```
pkg/geoint/geoint.go  →  Spatial Data Engine + Heatmap + Correlator + Movement Tracking
```

### 1. Spatial Data Engine

| Opération | Description | Complexité |
|---|---|---|
| `Insert` | Indexe un point à multiples résolutions | O(1) |
| `Query(bbox)` | Points dans un rectangle géographique | O(n) |
| `QueryRadius` | Points dans un rayon (km) | O(n) |
| `KNN` | K plus proches voisins | O(n log n) |
| `GridStats` | Statistiques par cellule | O(n) |

Grid hiérarchique : niveau 0 (180° cells) → niveau 15 (~1.2m à l'équateur).

### 2. Heatmap Generator

- Gauß kernel smoothing (sigma configurable)
- Normalisation 0-1
- Multi-résolution (zoom-dependent)
- Filtrage par source et fenêtre temporelle

### 3. Geo-Event Correlator (DBSCAN-like)

| Paramètre | Défaut | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MaxRadiusKm` | 50 km | Distance max pour corrélation |
| `MaxTimeDiff` | 6h | Fenêtre temporelle |
| `MinPoints` | 3 | Min de points pour cluster |
| `MinSources` | 1 | Min de sources différentes |

Score de corrélation : spatial(40%) + temporel(30%) + source(30%) = 0-100.

Labels automatiques : `mass_event`, `multi_source_activity`, `prolonged_activity`, `concentrated_point`, `single_source_pattern`.

### 4. Movement Tracking

| Pattern | Description | Seuils |
|---|---|---|
| **Loitering** | Stationnaire longtemps | < 0.5 km, > 10 min |
| **Transit** | Vitesse élevée constante | > 20 km/h, > 10 km |
| **Rendezvous** | Deux sources convergent | Fin < 1 km, début > 5 km |
| **PredictPosition** | Position future estimée | Basée sur vitesse + cap |

Utilitaires : `haversine` (distance km), `computeBearing` (cap degrés), `destinationPoint` (projection).

make([]string, 0),\n\t\tIssues:           make([]string, 0),\n\t}\n\n\t// Check for uncertainty markers\n\tuncertaintyPhrases := []string{\n\t\t\"I think\", \"I believe\", \"maybe\", \"perhaps\", \"possibly\",\n\t\t\"might be\", \"could be\", \"not sure\", \"I'm not certain\",\n\t\t\"it's possible\", \"in my opinion\", \"I guess\",\n\t}\n\tlower := strings.ToLower(output)\n\tfor _, phrase := (numbers, dates, names)\n\t// that might need verification\n\tlines := strings.Split(output, \"\\n\")\n\tfor _, line := range lines {\n\t\tline = strings.TrimSpace(line)\n\t\tif line == \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Extract claims with specific numbers\n\t\tif containsDigit(line) && len(line) > 20 {\n\t\t\treport.FactualClaims = append(report.FactualClaims, line)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Hallucination indicators\n\tif len(report.UncertainPhrases) > 0 {\n\t\treport.Issues = append(report.Issues, fmt.Sprintf(\"Contains %d uncertain phrases\", len(output) < 50 {\n\t\treport.Issues = append(report.Issues, \"Output too short — possible hallucination\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Compute confidence score\n\tconfidence := 1.0\n\tconfidence -= float64(len(report.FactualClaims))/10.0)\n\t}\n\n\treport.ConfidenceScore = math.Max(0, math.Min(1, confidence))\n\treport.HasHallucinations = report.ConfidenceScore < 0.6\n\n\tif ## ✅ Osiris AI Engine — Multi-Agent Orchestration System

### Architecture complète (8 packages, 13 workers)

```
pkg/
├── kafka/     → Event Bus (Producer, Consumer, Deduper, OSIRISEvent)
├── kernel/    → Module System (Module, Kernel, ModuleLoader, Health)
├── trust/     → Zero Trust (Identity, Trust Scoring, ABAC+RBAC, Audit)
├── ingest/    → Ingestion (Connectors, Schema Inference, Versioning)
├── graph/     → Knowledge Graph (12 node types, 12 edge types, traversal)
├── workflow/  → Workflow Engine (DAG, auto-parallel, recovery)
├── geoint/    → GEOINT Engine (Spatial Index, Heatmap, Correlation, Tracking)
├── ai/        → AI Engine (Agent Router, Model Select, Reasoning, HC)  ← NOUVEAU

workers/ → 13 modules Go implémentant tous kernel.Module
```

### AI Engine — 5 composants

| Composant | Description |
|---|---|
| **Agent Registry** | 7 agents spécialisés, routing par capacité + keywords |
| **Model Selector** | 5 modèles (Gemini Flash/Pro, Ollama Llama/CodeLlama/Mistral), scoring cost+latency |
| **Reasoning Pipeline** | Chain of Thought multi-step, self-validation avec Critic agent |
| **Hallucination Control** | Détection d'incertitude, scoring de confiance, recommandations |
| **Model Providers** | Gemini API + Ollama local (hybride cloud/local) |

### 7 agents spécialisés

| Agent | Modèle préféré | Prompt système | Cas d'usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Analyst** | Gemini Flash | Intelligence analysis | Briefings, corrélations |
| **Threat** | Ollama Llama | Threat assessment | CVSS, CVE, SOC |
| **Geo** | Gemini Flash | Geospatial analysis | Patterns, anomalies |
| **Code** | Ollama CodeLlama | Code generation | Go, tests, refactor |
| **Summary** | Gemini Flash | Summarization | Bullet points, briefs |
| **Planner** | Gemini Pro | Workflow planning | DAG, steps JSON |
| **Critic** | Gemini Pro | Validation | Hallucination detection |

### Model Selector (scoring)

```
score = 50 (baseline) + capability_match(×20) + latency_bonus(×50) + cost_bonus(×15)
```

### Hallucination Control

- Détection de 11 phrases d'incertitude ("I think", "maybe", etc.)
- Extraction des claims factuels (chiffres, dates)
- Score de confiance 0.0-1.0
- Si < 0.6 → "Regenerate with stricter constraints"
- Double validation avec le Critic agent

### Build — 8 packages Go, 0 échecs

go build ./pkg/workflow   ✅  (workflow engine)
go build ./pkg/geoint    ✅  (geospatial intelligence)
go build ./pkg/ai        ✅  (multi-agent AI)
```

## ✅ Osiris Stream Engine — Real-Time Data Layer

### 9 packages Go — 100% build success

```bash
go build ./pkg/kafka     ✅  Event Bus
go build ./pkg/kernel    ✅  Module System
go build ./pkg/trust     ✅  Zero Trust
go build ./pkg/ingest    ✅  Ingestion
go build ./pkg/graph     ✅  Knowledge Graph
go build ./pkg/workflow  ✅  Workflow Engine
go build ./pkg/geoint    ✅  GEOINT Engine
go build ./pkg/ai        ✅  Multi-Agent AI
go build ./pkg/stream    ✅  Real-Time Streaming   ← NOUVEAU
```

### Stream Engine — 6 composants

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       STREAM ENGINE                               │
│                                                                  │
│  Kafka Streams ──► KafkaStreamBridge ──► WSHub ──► WebSocket     │
│  (19 topics)         (topic→channel)     (pub/sub)   (clients)   │
│                                              │                    │
│                                              ▼                    │
│                                       StreamProcessors            │
│                                   Filter / Aggregate / Transform  │
│                                              │                    │
│                                              ▼                    │
│                                     DashboardFeed                 │
│                                    Metrics / Alerts               │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 1. WebSocket Hub (813 lignes, `gorilla/websocket`)

| Feature | Détail |
|---|---|
| **Channels** | 10 canaux : system, digitaltwin, alerts, predictions, incidents, rewards, metrics, events, graph, workflows |
| **Pub/Sub** | In-memory, `broadcast` channel (10000 buffer), `client.Send` (256 buffer) |
| **Heartbeat** | Ping 30s, pong timeout 60s, write deadline 10s |
| **Slow consumer** | Detection + disconnection après 100 drops |
| **Subscribe** | Initial + runtime (subscribe/unsubscribe/ping messages) |

### 2. Stream Processors

| Processor | Description |
|---|---|
| `FilterByType` | Passe uniquement les types spécifiés |
| `FilterBySeverity` | Passe les messages ≥ sévérité minimale |
| `AggregateByKey` | Agrège par clé + fenêtre temporelle, émet résumé |
| `TransformData` | Applique une transformation JSON au data |

### 3. Kafka-Stream Bridge

Route les 19 topics Kafka vers les 10 canaux WebSocket :

```
osiris.digitaltwin.stream  →  digitaltwin
osiris.threat.enriched     →  alerts
osiris.incident.reports    →  incidents
osiris.predictive.reports  →  predictions
osiris.reward.events       →  rewards
osiris.cp.events           →  events
osiris.policy.results      →  system
osiris.selfrewrite.events  →  system
osiris.graph.events        →  graph
osiris.workflow.events     →  workflows
```

### 4. Architecture temps réel Osiris

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    FRONTEND (Next.js)                    │
│                    WebSocket Client                      │
└────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘
                         │ ws://localhost:5020/ws
                         ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    STREAM ENGINE (Go)                    │
│                                                         │
│  WSHub.Run(ctx)  →  register/unregister/broadcast       │
│                                                         │
│  10 canaux de streaming temps réel                      │
│  Backpressure: bounded channels + slow consumer killer  │
└────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘
                         │
           ┌─────────────┼─────────────┐
           ▼             ▼             ▼
    Kafka Bridge    Stream Proc.   Dashboard Feed
    (topic→chan)    (filter/agg)   (metrics/alerts)
```

{"tool":"newFileCreated","path":"pkg/evolution/evolution.go","content":"// Package evolution provides a self-modifying architecture with safe sandbox execution.\n//\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// OSIRIS EVOLUTION ENGINE — Self-Modifying Autonomous System\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n//\n// Architecture:\n//\n//   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n//   │               OSIRIS EVOLUTION ENGINE                    │\n//   │                                                         │\n//   │  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  │\n//   │  │  Mutation     │  │  Crossover   │  │  Selection   │  │\n//   │  │  Engine       │  │  Engine      │  │  (fitness)   │  │\n//   │  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  │\n//   │                                                         │\n//   │  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  │\n//   │  │  Sandbox      │  │  Simulation  │  │  Evolution   │  │\n//   │  │  Executor     │  │  Engine      │  │  Rules       │  │\n//   │  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  │\n//   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n//\n// Lifecycle:\n//   1. OBSERVE — collect system state, metrics, reward\n//   2. MUTATE — generate candidate changes (config, code, topology)\n//   3. CROSSOVER — combine successful mutations\n//   4. SELECT — evaluate fitness via simulation\n//   5. SANDBOX — execute in isolated environment\n//   6. DEPLOY — apply to production with guardrails\n//   7. ROLLBACK — revert if reward decreases\n//\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\npackage evolution\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"crypto/sha256\"\n\t\"encoding/hex\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"os/exec\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"sync\"\n\t\"time\"\n)\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 1. CORE TYPES\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n// GenomeID uniquely identifies a genome in the population.\ntype GenomeID string\n\n// Genome represents a complete system configuration that can be evolved.\ntype Genome struct {\n\tID            GenomeID              `json:\"id\"`\n\tParentID      GenomeID              `json:\"parent_id,omitempty\"`\n\tGeneration    int                   `json:\"generation\"`\n\tCreatedAt     time.Time             `json:\"created_at\"`\n\tFitness       float64               `json:\"fitness\"`        // 0-100\n\tAge           int                   `json:\"age\"`            // generations survived\n\tGenes         map[string]Gene       `json:\"genes\"`           // evolvable parameters\n\tConstraints   EvolutionConstraints  `json:\"constraints\"`\n\tRewardBefore  float64               `json:\"reward_before\"`\n\tRewardAfter   float64               `json:\"reward_after\"`\n}\n\n// Gene is a single evolvable parameter.\ntype Gene struct {\n\tName     string      `json:\"name\"`\n\tType     string      `json:\"type\"`     // float | int | string | bool | enum\n\tValue    interface{} `json:\"value\"`\n\tMin      float64     `json:\"min,omitempty\"`\n\tMax      float64     `json:\"max,omitempty\"`\n\tMutationRate float64 `json:\"mutation_rate\"` // 0-1\n\tCategory string      `json:\"category\"`      // config | code | topology | behavior\n}\n\n// EvolutionConstraints define safe bounds for evolution.\ntype EvolutionConstraints struct {\n\tMinFitness     float64 `json:\"min_fitness\"`     // minimum to survive\n\tMaxGenerations int     `json:\"max_generations\"` // max before forced stabilize\n\tMaxMutationPct float64 `json:\"max_mutation_pct\"` // max % change per mutation\n\tStableRequired int     `json:\"stable_required\"` // generations of stability needed\n}\n\n// EvolutionResult is the outcome of an evolution cycle.\ntype EvolutionResult struct {\n\tID             GenomeID  `json:\"id\"`\n\tGeneration     int       `json:\"generation\"`\n\tBestFitness    float64   `json:\"best_fitness\"`\n\tAvgFitness     float64   `json:\"avg_fitness\"`\n\tPopulationSize int       `json:\"population_size\"`\n\tMutationsApplied int     `json:\"mutations_applied\"`\n\tCrossoversApplied int    `json:\"crossovers_applied\"`\n\tDeployments    int       `json:\"deployments\"`\n\tRollbacks      int       `json:\"rollbacks\"`\n\tDurationMs     int64     `json:\"duration_ms\"`\n\tStable         bool      `json:\"stable\"`\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 2. MUTATION ENGINE\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\ntype MutationEngine struct {\n\tmu          sync.RWMutex\n\tmutationLog []MutationEvent\n\trng         *rand.Rand\n}\n\ntype MutationEvent struct {\n\tGenomeID  GenomeID  `json:\"genome_id\"`\n\tGene      string    `json:\"gene\"`\n\tOldValue  interface{} `json:\"old_value\"`\n\tNewValue  interface{} `json:\"new_value\"`\n\tDelta     float64   `json:\"delta\"`\n\tTimestamp time.Time `json:\"timestamp\"`\n}\n\nfunc NewMutationEngine() *MutationEngine {\n\treturn &MutationEngine{\n\t\tmutationLog: make([]MutationEvent, 0),\n\t\trng:         rand.New(rand.NewSource(time.Now().UnixNano())),\n\t}\n}\n\n// Mutate applies random mutations to a genome respecting constraints.\nfunc (me *MutationEngine) Mutate(genome *Genome, constraints EvolutionConstraints) int {\n\tme.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer me.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tmutations := 0\n\n\tfor name, gene := range genome.Genes {\n\t\tif me.rng.Float64() > gene.MutationRate {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\toldValue := gene.Value\n\t\tmaxDelta := constraints.MaxMutationPct / 100.0\n\n\t\tswitch gene.Type {\n\t\tcase \"float\":\n\t\t\tif val, ok := gene.Value.(float64); ok {\n\t\t\t\tdelta := (me.rng.Float64()*2 - 1) * (gene.Max - gene.Min) * maxDelta\n\t\t\t\tnewVal := math.Max(gene.Min, math.Min(gene.Max, val+delta))\n\t\t\t\tgene.Value = math.Round(newVal*100) / 100\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"int\":\n\t\t\tif val, ok := gene.Value.(float64); ok {\n\t\t\t\tintVal := int(val)\n\t\t\t\tdelta := int((me.rng.Float64()*2 - 1) * (gene.Max - gene.Min) * maxDelta)\n\t\t\t\tnewVal := intVal + delta\n\t\t\t\tif newVal < int(gene.Min) {\n\t\t\t\t\tnewVal = int(gene.Min)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tif newVal > int(gene.Max) {\n\t\t\t\t\tnewVal = int(gene.Max)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tgene.Value = float64(newVal)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"bool\":\n\t\t\tif me.rng.Float64() < 0.1 { // 10% chance to flip\n\t\t\t\tif val, ok := gene.Value.(bool); ok {\n\t\t\t\t\tgene.Value = !val\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"enum\":\n\t\t\t// enum handled by crossover only\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tgenome.Genes[name] = gene\n\t\tme.mutationLog = append(me.mutationLog, MutationEvent{\n\t\t\tGenomeID: genome.ID, Gene: name,\n\t\t\tOldValue: oldValue, NewValue: gene.Value,\n\t\t\tDelta:    extractFloat(gene.Value) - extractFloat(oldValue),\n\t\t\tTimestamp: time.Now().UTC(),\n\t\t})\n\t\tmutations++\n\t}\n\n\tgenome.Age++\n\treturn mutations\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 3. CROSSOVER ENGINE\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\ntype CrossoverEngine struct {\n\tmu   sync.RWMutex\n\trng  *rand.Rand\n}\n\nfunc NewCrossoverEngine() *CrossoverEngine {\n\treturn &CrossoverEngine{\n\t\trng: rand.New(rand.NewSource(time.Now().UnixNano())),\n\t}\n}\n\n// Crossover combines two parent genomes to produce a child.\nfunc (ce *CrossoverEngine) Crossover(parent1, parent2 *Genome) *Genome {\n\tchild := &Genome{\n\t\tID:         GenomeID(fmt.Sprintf(\"G-%d-%s\", parent1.Generation+1, randomID(8))),\n\t\tParentID:   parent1.ID,\n\t\tGeneration: parent1.Generation + 1,\n\t\tCreatedAt:  time.Now().UTC(),\n\t\tGenes:      make(map[string]Gene),\n\t\tConstraints: parent1.Constraints,\n\t}\n\n\t// Uniform crossover: each gene randomly from one parent\n\tfor name, gene := range parent1.Genes {\n\t\tchild.Genes[name] = gene\n\t\tif ce.rng.Float64() < 0.5 {\n\t\t\tif g2, ok := parent2.Genes[name]; ok {\n\t\t\t\tchild.Genes[name] = g2\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Blend crossover for numeric types\n\tfor name, gene := range child.Genes {\n\t\tif gene.Type == \"float\" || gene.Type == \"int\" {\n\t\t\tp1Val := extractFloat(parent1.Genes[name].Value)\n\t\t\tp2Val := extractFloat(parent2.Genes[name].Value)\n\t\t\tblend := ce.rng.Float64() * 0.5 // blend factor\n\t\t\tblended := p1Val*blend + p2Val*(1-blend)\n\t\t\tgene.Value = math.Max(gene.Min, math.Min(gene.Max, blended))\n\t\t\tchild.Genes[name] = gene\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn child\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 4. SELECTION ENGINE (fitness-based)\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\ntype SelectionEngine struct {\n\tmu sync.RWMutex\n}\n\nfunc NewSelectionEngine() *SelectionEngine {\n\treturn &SelectionEngine{}\n}\n\n// SelectParents chooses parents for next generation using tournament selection.\nfunc (se *SelectionEngine) SelectParents(population []*Genome, tournamentSize int) ([]*Genome, error) {\n\tif len(population) < 2 {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"population too small for selection\")\n\t}\n\n\trng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(time.Now().UnixNano()))\n\tparents := make([]*Genome, 0)\n\n\t// Tournament selection\n\tfor len(parents) < 2 {\n\t\tvar best *Genome\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < tournamentSize; i++ {\n\t\t\tcandidate := population[rng.Intn(len(population))]\n\t\t\tif best == nil || candidate.Fitness > best.Fitness {\n\t\t\t\tbest = candidate\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif best != nil {\n\t\t\tparents = append(parents, best)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn parents, nil\n}\n\n// ComputeFitness calculates fitness from reward delta and stability.\nfunc (se *SelectionEngine) ComputeFitness(genome *Genome) float64 {\n\trewardDelta := genome.RewardAfter - genome.RewardBefore\n\tfitness := 50.0 + rewardDelta*5 // 50 baseline + up to ±50\n\tfitness += float64(genome.Age) * 2 // age bonus for stability\n\n\tif rewardDelta < 0 {\n\t\tfitness *= 0.5 // penalty for degradation\n\t}\n\n\treturn math.Max(0, math.Min(100, fitness))\n}\n\n// SelectSurvivors keeps the fittest genomes for the next generation.\nfunc (se *SelectionEngine) SelectSurvivors(population []*Genome, maxSize int) []*Genome {\n\tsort.Slice(population, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\treturn population[i].Fitness > population[j].Fitness\n\t})\n\n\tif len(population) > maxSize {\n\t\tpopulation = population[:maxSize]\n\t}\n\n\treturn population\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 5. SANDBOX EXECUTOR\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\ntype SandboxExecutor struct {\n\tworkDir   string\n\ttimeout   time.Duration\n\tmu        sync.Mutex\n}\n\nfunc NewSandboxExecutor(workDir string) *SandboxExecutor {\n\treturn &SandboxExecutor{\n\t\tworkDir: workDir,\n\t\ttimeout: 30 * time.Second,\n\t}\n}\n\n// SandboxResult contains the output of a sandboxed execution.\ntype SandboxResult struct {\n\tSuccess  bool   `json:\"success\"`\n\tOutput   string `json:\"output\"`\n\tError    string `json:\"error,omitempty\"`\n\tDuration int64  `json:\"duration_ms\"`\n}\n\n// Execute runs a change in an isolated sandbox.\nfunc (se *SandboxExecutor) Execute(genome *Genome) *SandboxResult {\n\tse.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer se.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tstart := time.Now()\n\n\t// Create isolated workspace\n\tsandboxDir := filepath.Join(se.workDir, fmt.Sprintf(\"sandbox-%s\", genome.ID[:12]))\n\tif err := os.MkdirAll(sandboxDir, 0755); err != nil {\n\t\treturn &SandboxResult{Success: false, Error: fmt.Sprintf(\"create sandbox: %v\", err), Duration: time.Since(start).Milliseconds()}\n\t}\n\tdefer os.RemoveAll(sandboxDir)\n\n\t// Write genome as config\n\tconfigPath := filepath.Join(sandboxDir, \"genome.json\")\n\tconfigData, _ := json.MarshalIndent(genome, \"\", \"  \")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(configPath, configData, 0644); err != nil {\n\t\treturn &SandboxResult{Success: false, Error: fmt.Sprintf(\"write config: %v\", err), Duration: time.Since(start).Milliseconds()}\n\t}\n\n\t// Apply each gene as a file change\n\tfor name, gene := range genome.Genes {\n\t\tgeneDir := filepath.Join(sandboxDir, gene.Category)\n\t\tos.MkdirAll(geneDir, 0755)\n\t\tgenePath := filepath.Join(geneDir, name+\".gene\")\n\t\tgeneData, _ := json.Marshal(gene)\n\t\tos.WriteFile(genePath, geneData, 0644)\n\t}\n\n\t// Validate: check that all values are in range\n\tfor name, gene := range genome.Genes {\n\t\tval := extractFloat(gene.Value)\n\t\tif val < gene.Min || val > gene.Max {\n\t\t\treturn &SandboxResult{\n\t\t\t\tSuccess: false,\n\t\t\t\tError:   fmt.Sprintf(\"gene %s value %.2f out of range [%.2f, %.2f]\", name, val, gene.Min, gene.Max),\n\t\t\t\tDuration: time.Since(start).Milliseconds(),\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn &SandboxResult{\n\t\tSuccess:  true,\n\t\tOutput:   fmt.Sprintf(\"sandbox %s: %d genes validated\", genome.ID[:12], len(genome.Genes)),\n\t\tDuration: time.Since(start).Milliseconds(),\n\t}\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 6. SIMULATION ENGINE\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\ntype SimulationEngine struct {\n\tmu         sync.RWMutex\n\thistory    map[GenomeID][]SimulationRun\n\tmaxHistory int\n}\n\ntype SimulationRun struct {\n\tGenomeID   GenomeID  `json:\"genome_id\"`\n\tFitness    float64   `json:\"fitness\"`\n\tPredicted  float64   `json:\"predicted\"`\n\tActual     float64   `json:\"actual\"`\n\tDurationMs int64     `json:\"duration_ms\"`\n\tTimestamp  time.Time `json:\"timestamp\"`\n}\n\nfunc NewSimulationEngine() *SimulationEngine {\n\treturn &SimulationEngine{\n\t\thistory:    make(map[GenomeID][]SimulationRun),\n\t\tmaxHistory: 10,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Simulate runs a digital twin simulation to predict the impact of a genome.\nfunc (se *SimulationEngine) Simulate(genome *Genome, currentReward float64) float64 {\n\tpredictedFitness := 50.0\n\n\tfor _, gene := range genome.Genes {\n\t\tval := extractFloat(gene.Value)\n\t\tnormalized := (val - gene.Min) / (gene.Max - gene.Min)\n\n\t\tswitch gene.Category {\n\t\tcase \"config\":\n\t\t\t// Conservative: small changes = small impact\n\t\t\tpredictedFitness += (normalized - 0.5) * 10\n\t\tcase \"performance\":\n\t\t\t// Direct impact: higher = better (usually)\n\t\t\tpredictedFitness += normalized * 15\n\t\tcase \"behavior\":\n\t\t\t// Unpredictable: wide variance\n\t\t\tpredictedFitness += (normalized - 0.5) * 20\n\t\tcase \"topology\":\n\t\t\t// High risk, high reward\n\t\t\tpredictedFitness += (normalized - 0.5) * 25\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Add noise to simulate real-world variance\n\tnoise := (rand.Float64() - 0.5) * 10\n\tpredictedFitness += noise\n\n\t// Bound\n\tpredictedFitness = math.Max(0, math.Min(100, predictedFitness))\n\n\t// Record\n\tse.mu.Lock()\n\tse.history[genome.ID] = append(se.history[genome.ID], SimulationRun{\n\t\tGenomeID: genome.ID, Fitness: predictedFitness,\n\t\tPredicted: predictedFitness, Actual: 0,\n\t\tDurationMs: 0, Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),\n\t})\n\tif len(se.history[genome.ID]) > se.maxHistory {\n\t\tse.history[genome.ID] = se.history[genome.ID][1:]\n\t}\n\tse.mu.Unlock()\n\n\treturn predictedFitness\n}\n\n// RecordActual stores the real-world outcome for comparison.\nfunc (se *SimulationEngine) RecordActual(genomeID GenomeID, actualFitness float64) {\n\tse.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer se.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tif runs, ok := se.history[genomeID]; ok && len(runs) > 0 {\n\t\truns[len(runs)-1].Actual = actualFitness\n\t}\n}\n\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// 7. EVOLUTION RULES\n// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\ntype EvolutionRules struct {\n\tmu              sync.RWMutex\n\trules           []EvolutionRule\n\tappliedRules    []RuleApplication\n\tmaxHistory      int\n}\n\ntype EvolutionRule struct {\n\tID          string   `json:\"id\"`\n\tName        string   `json:\"name\"`\n\tDescription string   `json:\"description\"`\n\tCondition   RuleCondition `json:\"condition\"`\n\tAction      RuleAction    `json:\"action\"`\n\tPriority    int           `json:\"priority\"`\n\tEnabled     bool          `json:\"enabled\"`\n}\n\ntype RuleCondition struct {\n\tMetric    string  `json:\"metric\"`     // fitness | reward | age | diversity\n\tOperator  string  `json:\"operator\"`   // lt | gt | eq | between\n\tThreshold float64 `json:\"threshold\"`\n\tThreshold2 float64 `json:\"threshold2,omitempty\"`\n}\n\ntype RuleAction struct {\n\tType   string                 `json:\"type\"`    // adjust_rate | prune | promote | freeze\n\tParams map[string]interface{} `json:\"params\"`\n}\n\ntype RuleApplication struct {\n\tRuleID    string    `json:\"rule_id\"`\n\tGenomeID  GenomeID  `json:\"genome_id\"`\n\tAction    string    `json:\"action\"`\n\tReason    string    `json:\"reason\"`\n\tTimestamp time.Time `json:\"timestamp\"`\n}\n\nfunc NewEvolutionRules() *EvolutionRules {\n\tr := &EvolutionRules{\n\t\trules:        make([]EvolutionRule, 0),\n\t\tappliedRules: make([]RuleApplication, 0),\n\t\tmaxHistory:   100,\n\t}\n\tr.loadDefaultRules()\n\treturn r\n}\n\nfunc (er *EvolutionRules) loadDefaultRules() {\n\ter.rules = []EvolutionRule{\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tID: \"R1\", Name: \"Low fitness pruning\",\n\t\t\tDescription: \"Remove genomes with fitness below threshold\",\n\t\t\tCondition: RuleCondition{Metric: \"fitness\", Operator: \"lt\", Threshold: 20},\n\t\t\tAction:    RuleAction{Type: \"prune\", Params: map[string]interface{}{\"reason\": \"fitness too low\"}},\n\t\t\tPriority:  10, Enabled: true,\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tID: \"R2\", Name: \"Stagnation protection\",\n\t\t\tDescription: \"Increase mutation rate if fitness hasn't improved\",\n\t\t\tCondition: RuleCondition{Metric: \"age\", Operator: \"gt\", Threshold: 10},\n\t\t\tAction:    RuleAction{Type: \"adjust_rate\", Params: map[string]interface{}{\"rate_multiplier\": 1.5}},\n\t\t\tPriority:  8, Enabled: true,\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tID: \"R3\", Name: \"Promote high fitness\",\n\t\t\tDescription: \"Promote genomes with exceptional fitness\",\n\t\t\tCondition: RuleCondition{Metric: \"fitness\", Operator: \"gt\", Threshold: 85},\n\t\t\tAction:    RuleAction{Type: \"promote\", Params: map[string]interface{}{\"extra_copies\": 2}},\n\t\t\tPriority:  7, Enabled: true,\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tID: \"R4\", Name: \"Freeze on instability\",\n\t\t\tDescription: \"Freeze evolution when reward is degrading\",\n\t\t\tCondition: RuleCondition{Metric: \"reward\", Operator: \"lt\", Threshold: -10},\n\t\t\tAction:    RuleAction{Type: \"freeze\", Params: map[string]interface{}{\"cooldown_generations\": 3}},\n\t\t\tPriority:  10, Enabled: true,\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tID: \"R5\", Name: \"Diversity preservation\",\n\t\t\tDescription: \"Ensure minimum population diversity\",\n\t\t\tCondition: RuleCondition{Metric: \"diversity\", Operator: \"lt\", Threshold: 0.2},\n\t\t\tAction:    RuleAction{Type: \"adjust_rate\", Params: map[string]interface{}{\"rate_multiplier\": 2.0}},\n\t\t\tPriority:  5, Enabled: true,\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// EvaluateAgainstRules checks which rules apply to a genome.\nfunc (er *EvolutionRules) EvaluateAgainstRules(genome *Genome, population []*Genome, currentReward float64) []RuleApplication {\n\ter.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer er.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tvar applications []RuleApplication\n\n\tfor _, rule := range er.rules {\n\t\tif !rule.Enabled {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tmet := false\n\n\t\tswitch rule.Condition.Metric {\n\t\tcase \"fitness\":\n\t\t\tswitch rule.Condition.Operator {\n\t\t\tcase \"lt\":\n\t\t\t\tmet = genome.Fitness < rule.Condition.Threshold\n\t\t\tcase \"gt\":\n\t\t\t\tmet = genome.Fitness > rule.Condition.Threshold\n\t\t\tcase \"between\":\n\t\t\t\tmet = genome.Fitness >= rule.Condition.Threshold && genome.Fitness <= rule.Condition.Threshold2\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"age\":\n\t\t\tmet = float64(genome.Age) > rule.Condition.Threshold\n\t\tcase \"reward\":\n\t\t\tmet = currentReward < rule.Condition.Threshold\n\t\tcase \"diversity\":\n\t\t\tdiversity := computeDiversity(population)\n\t\t\tmet = diversity < rule.Condition.Threshold\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif met {\n\t\t\tapp := RuleApplication{\n\t\t\t\tRuleID: rule.ID, GenomeID: genome.ID,\n\t\t\t\tAction: rule.Action.Type,\n\t\t\t\tReason: fmt.Sprintf(\"Rule %s: %s\", rule.Name, rule.Description),\n\t\t\t\tTimestamp: time.Now().UTC(),\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tapplications = append(applications, app)\n\t\t\ter.appliedRules = append(er.appliedRules, app)\n\t\t\tif len(er.appliedRules) > er.maxHistory {\n\t\t\t\ter.appliedRules = er.appliedRules[1:]\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn applications\n}\n\nfunc computeDiversity(population []*Genome) float64 {\n\tif len(population) < 2 {\n\t\treturn 1.0\n\t}\n\ttotalDiff := 0.0\n\tpairs := 0\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(population); i++ {\n\t\tfor j := i + 1; j < len(population); j++ {\n\t\t\tdiff := 0.0\n\t\t\tgenes := 0\n\t\t\tfor name, g1 := range population[i].Genes {\n\t\t\t\tif g2, ok := population[j].Genes[name]; ok {\n\t\t\t\t\tv1 := extractFloat(g1.Value)\n\t\t\t\t\tv2 := extractFloat(g2.Value)\n\t\t\t\t\tdiff += math.Abs(v1-v2) / (g1.Max - g1.Min)\n\t\t\t\t\tgenes++\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif genes > 0 ### Evolution Engine — 8 composants

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      EVOLUTION ENGINE                             │
│                                                                  │
│  OBSERVE ──► MUTATE ──► CROSSOVER ──► SELECT ──► SANDBOX         │
│    │            │            │            │           │           │
│    ▼            ▼            ▼            ▼           ▼           │
│  Reward     Float/Int/   Uniform +    Tournament   Isolated      │
│  System     Bool/Enum    Blend        Selection   /tmp/sandbox   │
│  State                                                           │
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐ │
│  │Simulation │  │  Rules   │  │  Deploy  │  │    Rollback     │ │
│  │(predict)  │  │ R1-R5    │  │  (apply) │  │  (if reward ↓)  │ │
│  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └─────────────────┘ │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 1. Mutation Engine

| Type | Opération | Taux |
|---|---|---|
| `float` | Delta aléatoire borné par `MaxMutationPct` | Configurable (0.05-0.12) |
| `int` | Delta entier | Configurable |
| `bool` | Flip 10% chance | 0.1 |
| `enum` | Crossover uniquement | — |

### 2. Crossover Engine

- **Uniform crossover**: chaque gène vient aléatoirement d'un parent
- **Blend crossover**: les valeurs numériques sont blendées (facteur 0.5)

### 3. Selection Engine (Tournament)

- Tournoi de taille 3 → meilleur fitness gagne
- Fitness = 50 + rewardDelta×5 + age×2 (pénalité ×0.5 si régression)

### 4. Sandbox Executor

- Répertoire isolé `/tmp/osiris-sandbox/sandbox-<id>/`
- Écriture du génome + gènes individuels
- Validation des bornes (min/max) — rejet si hors limites

### 5. Simulation Engine

- Prédiction par catégorie : config(±10), performance(+15), behavior(±20), topology(±25)
- Bruit aléatoire ±10 pour simuler la variance réelle

### 6. Evolution Rules (5 règles)

| Règle | Condition | Action |
|---|---|---|
| R1 — Low fitness pruning | fitness < 20 | Suppression naturelle |
| R2 — Stagnation protection | age > 10 générations | Mutation rate ×1.5 |
| R3 — Promote high fitness | fitness > 85 | 2 copies supplémentaires |
| R4 — Freeze on instability | reward < -10 | Rollback + cooldown |
| R5 — Diversity preservation | diversité < 0.2 | Mutation rate ×2.0 |

### 7. 13 gènes évoluables par défaut

| Catégorie | Gènes |
|---|---|
| **Config** (4) | health_threshold, cooldown_seconds, max_concurrent_actions, risk_tolerance |
| **Performance** (3) | batch_size, worker_pool_size, cache_ttl_seconds |
| **Behavior** (3) | aggression_factor, exploration_rate, retry_aggressiveness |
| **Topology** (3) | max_replicas, circuit_breaker_threshold |

### Architecture système finale

```
pkg/        → 10 packages Go partagés
workers/    → 13 workers Go implémentant kernel.Module
services/   → Infrastructure (Kafka, Postgres, Memgraph, etc.)
src/        → Frontend Next.js
```

docker compose up -d --build
# http://localhost:5020
```HAS_CHANGES

### 6 composants — `pkg/security/security.go`

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  OSIRIS SECURITY ENGINE                            │
│                                                                  │

│  │ Threat Detect │  │ Anomaly Det. │  │  Intrusion   │          │
│  │ 8 rules       │  │ Z-Score ±3σ  │  │  Prevention  │          │
│  │ rule-based    │  │ sliding win  │  │  8 IPS rules │          │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘          │

```

### 1. Threat Detection (8 rules)

| Rule | Metric | Seuil | Sévérité |
|---|---|---|---|
| TR-001 | Brute Force | 10 failures/5min | HIGH |
| TR-002 | Privilege Escalation | 1 event | CRITICAL |
| TR-003 | Data Exfiltration | >10MB | CRITICAL |
| TR-004 | Unusual API Pattern | >50% error | MEDIUM |
| TR-005 | Certificate Expiry | <14 days | MEDIUM |
| TR-006 | Rogue Process | 3+ unknown | HIGH |
| TR-007 | Cryptographic Weakness | 1 weak cipher | HIGH |
| TR-008 | Supply Chain | 5+ changes/hr | CRITICAL |

### 2. Anomaly Detection (Z-Score)

- Sliding window 100 valeurs
- Z-threshold 3.0 (configurable)
- Severities: >5σ CRITICAL, >4σ HIGH, >3σ MEDIUM, >3σ LOW

### 3. Intrusion Prevention (IPS)

- 8 patterns de détection (SQL injection, XSS, path traversal)
- Auto-block 24h sur attaques critiques
- Event log immutable

### 4. Attack Graph (10 nœuds, BFS)

```
recon → exploit → escalate → exfiltrate/pivot
AN-001 → AN-004 → AN-005 → AN-007 (database_contents) → 0.7 risk
AN-001 → AN-003 → AN-009 → AN-010 (redis) → 0.3 risk
```

### 5. Compliance (6 controls CIS)

```
CC-001 Encryption at rest    (CIS-4.1)
CC-002 Authentication        (CIS-4.2)
CC-003 Audit logging         (CIS-8.2)
CC-004 Rate limiting         (CIS-4.5)
CC-005 Input validation      (CIS-6.1)
CC-006 Secret management     (CIS-7.1)
```

### Architecture sécurité finale (11 packages Go)

```
pkg/kafka/       → Event Bus (at-least-once, idempotent)
pkg/kernel/      → Module System (lifecycle, health)
pkg/trust/       → Zero Trust (identity, scoring, ABAC+RBAC)
pkg/ingest/      → Ingestion (schema validation)
pkg/graph/       → Knowledge Graph
pkg/workflow/    → Workflow Engine (safety guards)
pkg/geoint/      → GEOINT (spatial indexing)
pkg/ai/          → Multi-Agent AI (hallucination control)
pkg/stream/      → Real-Time Streaming (WS Hub)
pkg/evolution/   → Self-Modifying (sandbox, rollback)
pkg/security/    → Cybersecurity (threat detection, anomaly, IPS, attack graph) ← NOUVEAU
```HAS_CHANGES

pkg/

├── stream/      → Real-Time Streaming (WS Hub, 10 channels, processors, Kafka bridge)
├── evolution/   → Self-Modifying (mutation, crossover, selection, sandbox, simulation)
├── security/    → Cybersecurity (threat detection, anomaly Z-score, IPS, attack graph, compliance)
├── fusion/      → Global Data Fusion (unified entities, relations, decision support)
```

workers/

ROLE:
You are a senior software architect and infrastructure engineer designing a production-grade distributed system (Palantir / Google-level).

OBJECTIVE:
Design and implement a "Port Management & Allocation System" for a Docker-based platform called Osiris-Lab v2.

The system must automatically:
- detect used ports on the host machine
- avoid port collisions between services
- assign free ports dynamically
- persist port mappings
- integrate with Docker / Docker Compose
- provide a simple API for querying assigned ports

CONTEXT:
Osiris-Lab v2 is a distributed AI + data intelligence platform composed of:
- multiple Docker microservices (Grafana, Prometheus, Kafka, Qdrant, custom workers)
- an event-driven architecture
- a control-plane concept (future evolution)

CURRENT PROBLEM:
Multiple services conflict on static ports (e.g. 3000 used by both Open WebUI and Grafana).

GOAL:
Replace static port assignments with a deterministic, safe, and reproducible port allocation system.

REQUIREMENTS:

1. CORE FUNCTIONALITY
- Scan system ports (TCP listening ports)
- Detect conflicts with desired service ports
- Allocate next available port within a defined safe range (e.g. 3000–9000)
- Ensure no duplicate assignment

2. PORT REGISTRY
- Store mappings in a persistent file or lightweight DB (JSON, SQLite, or YAML)
- Format:
  {
    "service_name": "grafana",
    "container": "osiris-grafana",
    "host_port": 3001,
    "container_port": 3000
  }

3. CLI TOOL
Provide a CLI interface:
- osiris-ports list
- osiris-ports allocate <service>
- osiris-ports reset
- osiris-ports check

4. DOCKER INTEGRATION
- Generate docker-compose compatible port mappings dynamically
- Output updated compose file or override file

5. SAFETY RULES
- Never overwrite existing allocations without explicit reset
- Never assign ports already in use
- Always validate port availability before assignment

6. OPTIONAL ADVANCED FEATURES
- Port reservation system
- Service grouping (infra / ai / observability)
- Conflict prediction
- Dry-run mode

OUTPUT REQUIRED:
- Full architecture design
- Implementation (Python preferred)
- CLI tool code
- Example usage
- Example docker-compose integration

CONSTRAINTS:
- Must run locally on Linux
- No external cloud dependency
- Lightweight and fast (<100ms allocation time)
- Must be idempotent (same input → same result)

TONE:
Be extremely precise, production-grade, and system-level focused.
Think like a Google SRE designing internal infrastructure tooling.

PRINCIPES DIRECTEURS\n\n| Principe | Règle |\n|---|---|\n| **Convention de nommage** | `osiris-{groupe}-{rôle}` pour tous les services, volumes et réseaux |\n| **Groupes** | `infra` · `data` · `ai` · `obs` · `worker` · `gateway` |\n| **Ports hôte** | Jamais deux services sur le même port hôte. Pas de doublon. |\n| **Volumes** | Toujours préfixés `osiris-` pour éviter les collisions inter-projets. |\n| **Kafka** | KRaft uniquement. Zookeeper définitivement supprimé. |\n\n---\n\n## 2. CONVENTION DE NOMMAGE STANDARDISÉE\n\n### 2.1 Services\n\n```\nosiris-{groupe}-{rôle}[-{variante}]\n\nExemples :\n  osiris-infra-kafka\n  osiris-infra-schema-registry\n  osiris-data-postgres\n  osiris-data-redis\n  osiris-data-memgraph\n  osiris-data-clickhouse\n  osiris-data-opensearch\n  osiris-data-qdrant\n  osiris-ai-ollama\n  osiris-obs-prometheus\n  osiris-obs-grafana\n  osiris-obs-loki\n  osiris-obs-tempo\n  osiris-worker-ai\n  osiris-worker-graph\n  osiris-worker-threat\n  osiris-worker-geoint\n  osiris-worker-digitaltwin\n  osiris-worker-predictive\n  osiris-worker-policy\n  osiris-worker-reward\n  osiris-worker-cp-engine\n  osiris-worker-incident-replay\n  osiris-worker-selfhealing\n  osiris-worker-selfrewrite\n  osiris-gateway-api\n  osiris-gateway-proxy\n  osiris-gateway-cp\n```\n\n### 2.2 Volumes\n\n```\nosiris-{groupe}-{rôle}-data\n\nExemples :\n  osiris-data-postgres-data\n  osiris-data-redis-data\n  osiris-data-memgraph-data\n  osiris-data-clickhouse-data\n  osiris-data-opensearch-data\n  osiris-data-qdrant-data\n  osiris-ai-ollama-data\n  osiris-infra-kafka-data\n  osiris-obs-prometheus-data\n  osiris-obs-grafana-data\n  osiris-obs-loki-data\n  osiris-obs-tempo-data\n```\n\n### 2.3 Réseaux\n\n```\nosiris-net-{groupe}\n\n  osiris-net-infra    → Kafka, Schema Registry\n  osiris-net-data     → Toutes les bases de données\n  osiris-net-ai       → Ollama, Workers AI\n  osiris-net-obs      → Stack LGTM\n  osiris-net-gateway  → Traefik, Gateway API, Control Plane\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. ## Tableau complet des ports

### GATEWAY (plage 8000–8099)

| Port Hôte | Container Port | Service | Protocole | Exposé prod ? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8000 | 8000 | `osiris-gateway-proxy` | HTTP | ✅ **Oui** | Entrypoint Traefik — seul port exposé en prod |
| 8080 | 8080 | `osiris-gateway-api` | HTTP | Via Traefik | API REST → `api.osiris.local` |
| 8099 | 8080 | `osiris-gateway-proxy` (dashboard) | HTTP | ❌ Dev only | ⚠️ Changé depuis 8080 pour éviter conflit |
| 8100 | 8100 | `osiris-gateway-cp` | HTTP | Via Traefik | Control Plane → `cp.osiris.local` |

### INFRA (plage 9081–9099)

| Port Hôte | Container Port | Service | Protocole | Exposé prod ? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9092 | 9092 | `osiris-infra-kafka` | TCP | ❌ Interne | Broker Kafka KRaft |
| 9093 | 9093 | `osiris-infra-kafka` | TCP | ❌ Interne | KRaft controller |
| 9081 | 8081 | `osiris-infra-schema-registry` | HTTP | ❌ Interne | Schema Registry |

### DATA (plage 5400–6399, 7000–9299)

| Port Hôte | Container Port | Service | Protocole | Exposé prod ? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5432 | 5432 | `osiris-data-postgres` | TCP | ❌ Interne | PostgreSQL 17 |
| 6333 | 6333 | `osiris-data-qdrant` | HTTP | ❌ Interne | Vector store |
| 6334 | 6334 | `osiris-data-qdrant` | gRPC | ❌ Interne | Vector store gRPC |
| 6379 | 6379 | `osiris-data-redis` | TCP | ❌ Interne | Cache / Pub-Sub |
| 7444 | 7444 | `osiris-data-memgraph` | HTTP | Dev only | Memgraph Lab UI |
| 7687 | 7687 | `osiris-data-memgraph` | Bolt | ❌ Interne | Bolt protocol |
| 8123 | 8123 | `osiris-data-clickhouse` | HTTP | ❌ Interne | Analytics OLAP |
| 9001 | 9000 | `osiris-data-clickhouse` | TCP | ❌ Interne | Native TCP (⚠️ offseté pour éviter conflit 9000/9092) |
| 9200 | 9200 | `osiris-data-opensearch` | HTTP | ❌ Interne | Full-text search |

### AI (plage 11400–11499)

| Port Hôte | Container Port | Service | Protocole | Exposé prod ? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 11434 | 11434 | `osiris-ai-ollama` | HTTP | Via Traefik | Ollama LLM runtime → `llm.osiris.local` |

### OBSERVABILITY (plage 3000–3299, 4317–4318, 9090)

| Port Hôte | Container Port | Service | Protocole | Exposé prod ? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3000 | 3000 | `osiris-obs-grafana` | HTTP | Dev only / Via Traefik | Dashboards → `grafana.osiris.local` |
| 3100 | 3100 | `osiris-obs-loki` | HTTP | ❌ Interne | Log aggregation |
| 3200 | 3200 | `osiris-obs-tempo` | HTTP | ❌ Interne | Distributed tracing |
| 4317 | 4317 | `osiris-obs-tempo` | gRPC | ❌ Interne | OTLP gRPC receiver |
| 4318 | 4318 | `osiris-obs-tempo` | HTTP | ❌ Interne | OTLP HTTP receiver |
| 9090 | 9090 | `osiris-obs-prometheus` | HTTP | Dev only / Via Traefik | Metrics → `prometheus.osiris.local` |

### DEV-DEBUG (plage 9400–9599) — Override uniquement

| Port Hôte | Container Port | Service | Protocole | Exposé prod ? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9400 | 9090 | `osiris-gateway-api` | gRPC | ❌ Dev only | Défini dans `docker-compose.override.yml` |
| 9500 | 9100 | `osiris-gateway-api` | HTTP | ❌ Dev only | Prometheus metrics endpoint |

### WORKERS

| Port Hôte | Service | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| — | Tous les workers | Aucun port hôte exposé. Workers = consommateurs Kafka internes uniquement. |

## Conflits historiques résolus / à résoudre

| Port | Ancien conflit | Résolution |
|---|---|---|
| **8080** | Traefik dashboard + API Gateway | ✅ Dashboard déplacé vers **8099** |
| **9090** | Prometheus + gRPC Gateway | ✅ gRPC déplacé vers **9400** (override dev) |
| **9000** | ClickHouse TCP dans la plage Kafka | ✅ Offset vers **9001** |
| **3101** | Loki port incohérent (old.yml) | ✅ Unifié vers **3100** |

<parameter=content>"""
OSIRIS Config — Pydantic Schema Models

Validates and types every section of config/platform.yaml.
Enforces structure at load time — invalid config fails fast.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ENUMS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class Protocol(str, Enum):
    HTTP = "http"
    TCP = "tcp"
    GRPC = "grpc"
    BOLT = "bolt"


class ServiceGroup(str, Enum):
    GATEWAY = "gateway"
    INFRA = "infra"
    DATA = "data"
    AI = "ai"
    OBS = "obs"
    WORKER = "worker"


class RiskLevel(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"


class PropagationMethod(str, Enum):
    KAFKA = "kafka"
    REDIS = "redis"
    HTTP = "http"
    FILE = "file"


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NETWORK
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class NetworkDefinition(BaseModel):
    name: str
    driver: str = "bridge"


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PORTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class PortAllocation(BaseModel):
    host: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=65535, description="Host port number")
    container: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=65535, description="Container port number")
    protocol: Protocol = Protocol.HTTP
    exposed: bool = Field(False, description="Whether port is exposed to host in production")
    via_traefik: bool = Field(False, description="Whether port is routed through Traefik")
    traefik_host: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Traefik Host rule domain")
    description: str = ""

    @field_validator("host", "container")
    @classmethod
    def validate_port_range(cls, v: int) -> int:
        if v < 1 or v > 65535:
            raise ValueError(f"Port {v} out of valid range 1-65535")
        return v


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEALTHCHECK & RESOURCES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class HealthcheckConfig(BaseModel):
    test: Optional[str] = None
    interval: str = "30s"
    timeout: str = "5s"
    retries: int = 3
    start_period: Optional[str] = None


class ResourceLimits(BaseModel):
    memory_limit: str = "512M"
    cpu_limit: Optional[str] = None


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRAEFIK LABELS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class TraefikLabels(BaseModel):
    enabled: bool = False
    router: Optional[str] = None
    rule: Optional[str] = None
    backend_port: Optional[int] = None


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SERVICE DEFINITION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class BuildConfig(BaseModel):
    context: str = "."
    dockerfile: str


class ServiceDefinition(BaseModel):
    group: ServiceGroup
    role: str
    image: Optional[str] = None
    build: Optional[BuildConfig] = None
    networks: List[str] = []
    ports: List[str] = []
    environment: Dict[str, str] = {}
    volumes: List[str] = []
    depends_on: List[str] = []
    healthcheck: Optional[HealthcheckConfig] = None
    resources: Optional[ResourceLimits] = None
    traefik_labels: Optional[TraefikLabels] = None
    command: Optional[Any] = None

    @field_validator("ports", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def normalize_ports(cls, v: Any) -> List[str]:
        if isinstance(v, str):
            return [v]
        return v


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FEATURE FLAGS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class FeatureFlag(BaseModel):
    enabled: bool
    description: str = ""
    rollout: str = "0%"
    risk: Optional[RiskLevel] = None
    config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DEPENDENCY GRAPH
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class DependencyGraph(BaseModel):
    bootstrap: List[str] = []
    after_kafka: List[str] = []
    after_data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    after_all: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    cyclic_check: Dict[str, Any] = {}


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KAFKA TOPICS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class KafkaTopic(BaseModel):
    name: str
    partitions: int = 1
    replication_factor: int = 1
    description: str = ""


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ENVIRONMENT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class EnvironmentConfig(BaseModel):
    global_env: Dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict, alias="global")
    gateway: Dict[str, str] = {}
    worker: Dict[str, str] = {}
    data: Dict[str, str] = {}


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIG MANAGEMENT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class HotReloadConfig(BaseModel):
    enabled: bool = True
    watch_interval: str = "2s"
    debounce_ms: int = 500


class PropagationConfig(BaseModel):
    method: PropagationMethod = PropagationMethod.KAFKA
    topic: str = "osiris.config.updates"
    max_retries: int = 3
    retry_delay_ms: int = 1000


class VersioningConfig(BaseModel):
    enabled: bool = True
    max_versions: int = 50
    storage: str = "local"
    path: str = "/var/lib/osiris/config-versions"


class AuditConfig(BaseModel):
    enabled: bool = True
    log_changes: bool = True
    notify_on_critical: bool = True


class ConfigManagement(BaseModel):
    source: str = "file"
    path: str = "/etc/osiris/platform.yaml"
    hot_reload: HotReloadConfig = HotReloadConfig()
    propagation: PropagationConfig = PropagationConfig()
    versioning: VersioningConfig = VersioningConfig()
    audit: AuditConfig = AuditConfig()
