### Tour 1984 — Assistant

*2026-06-16 13:09:39 UTC*

Moteur de scoring de santé conçu et documenté dans `HEALTH_SCORING_ENGINE.md`.

**Scoring Formula (7 signaux pondérés) :**
- `lifecycle` (10%) — État du conteneur Docker
- `http_health` (25%) — Réponse du endpoint /health avec scoring de latence
- `tcp_health` (10%) — Connectivité port
- `dependency` (20%) — Santé des dépendances (via Graph Engine)
- `uptime` (15%) — Stabilité (penalise restarts, bonus uptime long)
- `latency` (10%) — Temps de réponse vs baseline p99
- `error_rate` (10%) — Taux d'échec des health checks

Score composite = Σ(weight × signal) × confidence_modifier (0.7-1.0 selon complétude des données)

**Mapping Score → Status :** ≥80=healthy, 50-79=degraded, 20-49=unhealthy, <20=critical

**Platform Aggregation :** Score moyen pondéré par groupe (data 30%, infra 25%, gateway 25%, worker 10%, ai 5%, obs 5%). SLI/SLO avec error budget (target 99.9%).

**Anomaly Detection (5 patterns) :**
1. Score drop (Δ > 30% → warning, > 50% → critical)
2. Oscillation/flapping (>3 swings in 6 checks)
3. Trend degradation (5 drops consécutifs)
4. Stale (> 5 min sans update)
5. Critical score (< 20)
+ Cascade failure detection (≥3 services unhealthy simultanément)

**Metrics Ingestion :** 10 sources de signaux (lifecycle, HTTP, TCP, deps, uptime, latency, error rate, CPU, memory, OOM). Pipeline: Signal Collectors → Signal Buffer (ring buffer) → Scoring Engine → Storage → Anomaly/Alerting.

**Alerting (8 rules) :** service_critical, service_unhealthy, service_degraded, service_restarting, platform_critical, platform_degraded, error_budget_exhausted, cascade_failure. Lifecycle: DETECTED→PENDING→FIRING→ACK/RESOLVED/EXPIRED. Deduplication, escalation (warning→critical→page→lead).

**12 métriques Prometheus** pour monitoring du moteur lui-même.HAS_CHANGES

EVENT SCHEMA DEFINITIONS\n\n### 3.1 Base Event Envelope\n\n```python\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Optional\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nimport uuid\nimport hashlib\n\n\nclass EventDomain(str, Enum):\n    \"\"\"Top-level event domains for routing and filtering.\"\"\"\n    CONTAINER  = \"container\"     # Docker container lifecycle events\n    SERVICE    = \"service\"       # Service registry state changes\n    HEALTH     = \"health\"        # Health check results and scoring\n    LIFECYCLE  = \"lifecycle\"     # Start/stop/restart operations\n    DEPENDENCY = \"dependency\"    # Dependency graph changes\n    CONFIG     = \"config\"        # Configuration updates\n    ALERT      = \"alert\"         # Alerting events\n    SYSTEM     = \"system\"        # Internal system events\n\n\nclass EventSeverity(str, Enum):\n    DEBUG    = \"debug\"\n    INFO     = \"info\"\n    WARNING  = \"warning\"\n    ERROR    = \"error\"\n    CRITICAL = \"critical\"\n\n\nclass EventPriority(int, Enum):\n    \"\"\"Dispatch priority — higher = processed first.\"\"\"\n    LOW      = 0\n    NORMAL   = 5\n    HIGH     = 10\n    CRITICAL = 20\n\n\nclass PlatformEvent(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"\n    Canonical event envelope for the Control Plane Event Bus.\n    \n    Every event flowing through the bus MUST conform to this schema.\n    Events are immutable once published.\n    \"\"\"\n    # ── Identity ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n    event_id: str = Field(\n        default_factory=lambda: f\"evt_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}\",\n        description=\"Globally unique event identifier\"\n    )\n    schema_version: str = Field(\n        default=\"1.0.0\",\n        description=\"Schema version for backward compatibility\"\n    )\n    \n    # ── Classification ────────────────────────────────────────\n    event_type: str = Field(\n        ...,\n        description=\"Dot-notation event type (e.g., container.started, health.failing)\"\n    )\n    domain: EventDomain = Field(\n        ...,\n        description=\"Top-level domain for routing\"\n    )\n    severity: EventSeverity = Field(\n        default=EventSeverity.INFO,\n        description=\"Event severity level\"\n    )\n    priority: EventPriority = Field(\n        default=EventPriority.NORMAL,\n        description=\"Dispatch priority\"\n    )\n    \n    # ── Source ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    source: str = Field(\n        ...,\n        description=\"Originating module (e.g., docker-adapter, health-monitor)\"\n    )\n    service_id: Optional[str] = Field(\n        default=None,\n        description=\"Related service name (if applicable)\"\n    )\n    container_id: Optional[str] = Field(\n        default=None,\n        description=\"Related Docker container ID (if applicable)\"\n    )\n    \n    # ── Temporal ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n    timestamp: datetime = Field(\n        default_factory=datetime.utcnow,\n        description=\"Event creation time (UTC)\"\n    )\n    received_at: Optional[datetime] = Field(\n        default=None,\n        description=\"Time event was received by the bus\"\n    )\n    \n    # ── Payload ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n    payload: Dict[str, Any] = Field(\n        default_factory=dict,\n        description=\"Event-specific data\"\n    )\n    \n    # ── Traceability ──────────────────────────────────────────\n    trace_id: Optional[str] = Field(\n        default=None,\n        description=\"Distributed trace ID for correlation\"\n    )\n    causation_id: Optional[str] = Field(\n        default=None,\n        description=\"ID of the event that caused this event (causal chain)\"\n    )\n    correlation_id: Optional[str] = Field(\n        default=None,\n        description=\"ID for correlating related events\"\n    )\n    \n    # ── Metadata ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(\n        default_factory=dict,\n        description=\"Extensible metadata (version info, etc.)\"\n    )\n\n    def compute_hash(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Compute deterministic hash for deduplication.\"\"\"\n        content = f\"{self.event_type}:{self.service_id}:{self.timestamp}:{self.payload}\"\n        return hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]\n\n    class Config:\n        frozen = True  # Events are immutable once created\n```\n\n### 3.2 Event Type Registry\n\n```python\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n# CONTROL PLANE EVENT TYPES — Canonical Registry\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\nEVENT_TYPES = {\n    \n    # api|self-healing|reconciliation\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Start operation initiated\",\n    },\n    \n    \"lifecycle.stop_requested\": {\n        \"domain\": \"lifecycle\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"cascade\": \"bool\",\n            \"force\": \"bool\",\n            \"requested_by\": \"str\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Stop operation initiated\",\n    },\n    \n    \"lifecycle.restart_requested\": {\n        \"domain\": \"lifecycle\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"force\": \"bool\",\n            \"requested_by\": \"str\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Restart operation initiated\",\n    },\n    \n    \"lifecycle.operation_completed\": {\n        \"domain\": \"lifecycle\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"operation\": \"str\",      # start|stop|restart\n            \"success\": \"bool\",\n            \"duration_ms\": \"int\",\n            \"error\": \"str|None\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Lifecycle operation completed\",\n    },\n    \n    \"lifecycle.operation_failed\": {\n        \"domain\": \"lifecycle\",\n        \"severity\": \"error\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"operation\": \"str\",\n            \"error\": \"str\",\n            \"retry_count\": \"int\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Lifecycle operation failed\",\n    },\n    \n    # ── Health Events (from Health Monitor) ────────────────────\n    \n    \"health.check_passed\": {\n        \"domain\": \"health\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"check_type\": \"str\",     # http|tcp|cmd|passive\n            \"latency_ms\": \"float\",\n            \"status_code\": \"int|None\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Health check passed\",\n    },\n    \n    \"health.check_failed\": {\n        \"domain\": \"health\",\n        \"severity\": \"warning\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"check_type\": \"str\",\n            \"error\": \"str\",\n            \"consecutive_failures\": \"int\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Health check failed\",\n    },\n    \n    \"health.score_changed\": {\n        \"domain\": \"health\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"old_score\": \"int\",\n            \"new_score\": \"int\",\n            \"old_status\": \"str\",\n            \"new_status\": \"str\",\n            \"signals\": \"dict\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Health score changed significantly (Δ > 10)\",\n    },\n    \n    \"health.status_changed\": {\n        \"domain\": \"health\",\n        \"severity\": \"warning\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"old_status\": \"str\",\n            \"new_status\": \"str\",\n            \"health_score\": \"int\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Health status transitioned (healthy→unhealthy, etc.)\",\n    },\n    \n    \"health.anomaly_detected\": {\n        \"domain\": \"health\",\n        \"severity\": \"warning\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"service_id\": \"str\",\n            \"anomaly_type\": \"str\",   # score_drop|oscillation|trend|stale|critical\n            \"detail\": \"str\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Health anomaly detected\",\n    },\n    \n    \"health.cascade_detected\": {\n        \"domain\": \"health\",\n        \"severity\": \"critical\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"affected_services\": \"list[str]\",\n            \"count\": \"int\",\n            \"trigger_service\": \"str|None\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Cascade failure detected (multiple services unhealthy)\",\n    },\n    \n    # ── Dependency Events ──────────────────────────────────────\n    \n    \"dependency.violation\": {\n        \"domain\": \"dependency\",\n        \"severity\": \"error\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"dependent_id\": \"str\",\n            \"dependency_id\": \"str\",\n            \"reason\": \"str\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Required dependency is unhealthy/down\",\n    },\n    \n    \"dependency.satisfied\": {\n        \"domain\": \"dependency\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"dependent_id\": \"str\",\n            \"dependency_id\": \"str\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Previously violated dependency is now healthy\",\n    },\n    \n    \"dependency.graph_rebuilt\": {\n        \"domain\": \"dependency\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"total_services\": \"int\",\n            \"total_edges\": \"int\",\n            \"has_cycles\": \"bool\",\n            \"layers\": \"int\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Dependency graph was rebuilt\",\n    },\n    \n    # ── Config Events ─────────────────────────────────────────\n    \n    \"config.updated\": {\n        \"domain\": \"config\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"changed_keys\": \"list[str]\",\n            \"config_version\": \"int\",\n            \"snapshot_hash\": \"str\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Platform configuration updated\",\n    },\n    \n    \"config.reload_failed\": {\n        \"domain\": \"config\",\n        \"severity\": \"error\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"error\": \"str\",\n            \"file_path\": \"str\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Configuration reload failed (validation error)\",\n    },\n    \n    # ── Alert Events ──────────────────────────────────────────\n    \n    \"alert.fired\": {\n        \"domain\": \"alert\",\n        \"severity\": \"warning\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"alert_id\": \"str\",\n            \"rule_name\": \"str\",\n            \"service_id\": \"str|None\",\n            \"message\": \"str\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Alert was fired\",\n    },\n    \n    \"alert.resolved\": {\n        \"domain\": \"alert\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"alert_id\": \"str\",\n            \"resolved_after_seconds\": \"int\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Alert condition resolved\",\n    },\n    \n    # ── System Events ─────────────────────────────────────────\n    \n    \"system.started\": {\n        \"domain\": \"system\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"version\": \"str\",\n            \"config_version\": \"int\",\n            \"services_tracked\": \"int\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Control Plane started\",\n    },\n    \n    \"system.health_check\": {\n        \"domain\": \"system\",\n        \"severity\": \"info\",\n        \"payload_schema\": {\n            \"uptime_seconds\": \"int\",\n            \"events_processed\": \"int\",\n            \"memory_usage_mb\": \"float\",\n        },\n        \"description\": \"Periodic system health self-check\",\n    },\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. PUBLISH/SUBSCRIBE MODEL\n\n### 4.1 Core EventBus Implementation\n\n```python\nimport asyncio\nimport logging\nimport fnmatch\nfrom collections import defaultdict, deque\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Coroutine, Dict, List, Optional, Set\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"osiris-event-bus\")\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Subscription:\n    \"\"\"Represents an active event subscription.\"\"\"\n    subscription_id: str\n    event_pattern: str           # Exact type or glob (e.g., \"container.*\")\n    handler: Callable            # Async handler function\n    filter_fn: Optional[Callable] = None  # Additional filter predicate\n    priority: EventPriority = EventPriority.NORMAL\n    domain_filter: Optional[Set[str]] = None\n    severity_filter: Optional[Set[str]] = None\n    source_filter: Optional[Set[str]] = None\n    service_filter: Optional[str] = None\n    is_active: bool = True\n    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)\n    events_received: int = 0\n    events_dropped: int = 0\n    errors: int = 0\n\n\nclass EventBus:\n    \"\"\"\n    Internal event bus for Control Plane module decoupling.\n    \n    Three-tier architecture:\n    1. In-process async dispatch (< 1ms latency)\n    2. Ring buffer for replay (last N events)\n    3. Optional external bridge (Redis/Kafka for cross-process)\n    \n    Thread-safe, non-blocking, error-isolated.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        ring_buffer_size: int = 1000,\n        max_handlers_per_event: int = 50,\n        handler_timeout_seconds: float = 10.0,\n    ):\n        self._subscriptions: Dict[str, List[Subscription]] = defaultdict(list)\n        self._all_subscriptions: List[Subscription] = []\n        self._ring_buffer: deque = deque(maxlen=ring_buffer_size)\n        self._max_handlers = max_handlers_per_event\n        self._handler_timeout = handler_timeout_seconds\n        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()\n        self._running = False\n        \n        # Stats\n        self._stats = {\n            \"published\": 0,\n            \"dispatched\": 0,\n            \"errors\": 0,\n            \"handlers_registered\": 0,\n            \"ring_buffer_size\": ring_buffer_size,\n        }\n        \n        # External bridges (optional)\n        self._bridges: List[EventBridge] = []\n\n    # ── Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    async def start(self):\n        \"\"\"Start the event bus.\"\"\"\n        self._running = True\n        logger.info(\"EventBus started\")\n\n    async def stop(self):\n        \"\"\"Gracefully stop the event bus.\"\"\"\n        self._running = False\n        for bridge in self._bridges:\n            await bridge.stop()\n        logger.info(f\"EventBus stopped. Stats: {self._stats}\")\n\n    # ── Publishing ─────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    async def publish(self, event: PlatformEvent) -> None:\n        \"\"\"\n        Publish an event to all matching subscribers.\n        \n        Execution model:\n        1. Add to ring buffer (for replay)\n        2. Find matching subscriptions\n        3. Dispatch to handlers (async, error-isolated)\n        4. Bridge to external systems (fire-and-forget)\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self._running:\n            logger.warning(f\"EventBus not running, dropping event {event.event_id}\")\n            return\n        \n        # Mark received time\n        event = event.model_copy(update={\"received_at\": datetime.utcnow()})\n        \n        # 1. Ring buffer (replay support)\n        self._ring_buffer.append(event)\n        \n        # 2. Find matching subscriptions\n        matching = self._find_matching_subscriptions(event)\n        \n        # 3. Dispatch to handlers\n        for sub in sorted(matching, key=lambda s: -s.priority.value):\n            if not sub.is_active:\n                continue\n            sub.events_received += 1\n            asyncio.create_task(self._safe_dispatch(sub, event))\n            self._stats[\"dispatched\"] += 1\n        \n        # 4. External bridges\n        for bridge in self._bridges:\n            if bridge.accepts(event):\n                asyncio.create_task(bridge.publish(event))\n        \n        self._stats[\"published\"] += 1\n\n    async def _safe_dispatch(self, subscription: Subscription, event: PlatformEvent):\n        \"\"\"Dispatch event to a handler with error isolation and timeout.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            handler = subscription.handler\n            if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(handler):\n                await asyncio.wait_for(\n                    handler(event),\n                    timeout=self._handler_timeout\n                )\n            else:\n                # Sync handler — run in executor\n                loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()\n                await asyncio.wait_for(\n                    loop.run_in_executor(None, handler, event),\n                    timeout=self._handler_timeout\n                )\n        except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n            subscription.errors += 1\n            self._stats[\"errors\"] += 1\n            logger.warning(\n                f\"Handler timeout for {subscription.event_pattern} \"\n                f\"(event={event.event_type})\"\n            )\n        except Exception as e:\n            subscription.errors += 1\n            self._stats[\"errors\"] += 1\n            logger.error(\n                f\"Handler error for {subscription.event_pattern}: {e} \"\n                f\"(event={event.event_id})\"\n            )\n\n    # ── Subscribing ────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    async def subscribe(\n        self,\n        event_pattern: str,\n        handler: Callable,\n        filter_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,\n        priority: EventPriority = EventPriority.NORMAL,\n        domain_filter: Optional[Set[str]] = None,\n        severity_filter: Optional[Set[str]] = None,\n        source_filter: Optional[Set[str]] = None,\n        service_filter: Optional[str] = None,\n    ) -> Subscription:\n        \"\"\"\n        Subscribe to events matching a pattern.\n        \n        Patterns:\n        - Exact:    \"container.started\"\n        - Domain:   \"container.*\" (all container events)\n        - Wildcard: \"*\" (all events)\n        \"\"\"\n        sub_id = f\"sub_{len(self._all_subscriptions) + 1:04d}\"\n        \n        subscription = Subscription(\n            subscription_id=sub_id,\n            event_pattern=event_pattern,\n            handler=handler,\n            filter_fn=filter_fn,\n            priority=priority,\n            domain_filter=domain_filter,\n            severity_filter=severity_filter,\n            source_filter=source_filter,\n            service_filter=service_filter,\n        )\n        \n        async with self._lock:\n            self._subscriptions[event_pattern].append(subscription)\n            self._all_subscriptions.append(subscription)\n            self._stats[\"handlers_registered\"] += 1\n        \n        logger.debug(f\"Subscription {sub_id} registered for pattern '{event_pattern}'\")\n        return subscription\n\n    async def unsubscribe(self, subscription: Subscription) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Remove a subscription.\"\"\"\n        subscription.is_active = False\n        async with self._lock:\n            if subscription.event_pattern in self._subscriptions:\n                self._subscriptions[subscription.event_pattern] = [\n                    s for s in self._subscriptions[subscription.event_pattern]\n                    if s.subscription_id != subscription.subscription_id\n                ]\n        logger.debug(f\"Subscription {subscription.subscription_id} removed\")\n\n    def _find_matching_subscriptions(self, event: PlatformEvent) -> List[Subscription]:\n        \"\"\"Find all subscriptions matching an event.\"\"\"\n        matches = []\n        \n        # Check exact match\n        for sub in self._subscriptions.get(event.event_type, []):\n            if self._passes_filters(sub, event):\n                matches.append(sub)\n        \n        # Check wildcard patterns\n        for pattern, subs in self._subscriptions.items():\n            if pattern == event.event_type:\n                continue  # Already checked\n            if fnmatch.fnmatch(event.event_type, pattern):\n                for sub in subs:\n                    if self._passes_filters(sub, event):\n                        matches.append(sub)\n        \n        return matches\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _passes_filters(sub: Subscription, event: PlatformEvent) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if event passes all subscription filters.\"\"\"\n        if not sub.is_active:\n            return False\n        if sub.domain_filter and event.domain.value not in sub.domain_filter:\n            return False\n        if sub.severity_filter and event.severity.value not in sub.severity_filter:\n            return False\n        if sub.source_filter and event.source not in sub.source_filter:\n            return False\n        if sub.service_filter and event.service_id != sub.service_filter:\n            return False\n        if sub.filter_fn and not sub.filter_fn(event):\n            return False\n        return True\n\n    # ── Replay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    def get_recent_events(\n        self,\n        n: int = 100,\n        event_type: Optional[str] = None,\n        service_id: Optional[str] = None,\n        since: Optional[datetime] = None,\n    ) -> List[PlatformEvent]:\n        \"\"\"Get recent events from ring buffer (for replay/debugging).\"\"\"\n        events = list(self._ring_buffer)\n        \n        if event_type:\n            events = [e for e in events if fnmatch.fnmatch(e.event_type, event_type)]\n        if service_id:\n            events = [e for e in events if e.service_id == service_id]\n        if since:\n            events = [e for e in events if e.timestamp >= since]\n        \n        return events[-n:]\n\n    # ── Bridges ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    def add_bridge(self, bridge: \"EventBridge\"):\n        \"\"\"Add an external event bridge (Redis, Kafka, etc.).\"\"\"\n        self._bridges.append(bridge)\n\n    # ── Stats ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    def stats(self) -> dict:\n        return {\n            **self._stats,\n            \"ring_buffer_used\": len(self._ring_buffer),\n            \"active_subscriptions\": sum(\n                1 for s in self._all_subscriptions if s.is_active\n            ),\n            \"total_subscriptions\": len(self._all_subscriptions),\n        }\n\n    def subscription_details(self) -> List[dict]:\n        \"\"\"Get details of all active subscriptions (for debugging).\"\"\"\n        return [\n            {\n                \"id\": s.subscription_id,\n                \"pattern\": s.event_pattern,\n                \"priority\": s.priority.name,\n                \"events_received\": s.events_received,\n                \"errors\": s.errors,\n                \"created_at\": s.created_at.isoformat(),\n            }\n            for s in self._all_subscriptions\n            if s.is_active\n        ]\n```\n\n### 4.2 Event Bridge (External)\n\n```python\nclass EventBridge:\n    \"\"\"\n    Bridge for forwarding events to external systems.\n    Base class — implement for Redis, Kafka, etc.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, name: str):\n        self.name = name\n        self._running = False\n\n    def accepts(self, event: PlatformEvent) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Override to filter which events this bridge handles.\"\"\"\n        return True\n\n    async def publish(self, event: PlatformEvent) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Publish event to external system. Override in subclass.\"\"\"\n        raise NotImplementedError\n\n    async def start(self):\n        self._running = True\n\n    async def stop(self):\n        self._running = False\n\n\nclass RedisBridge(EventBridge):\n    \"\"\"\n    Redis Pub/Sub bridge for cross-process event delivery.\n    Uses Redis Streams for durability (optional).\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        name: str = \"redis\",\n        redis_url: str = \"redis://[REDACTED:PASSWORD]@classmethod\n    def is_compatible(cls, event_version: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if an event version is compatible with current.\"\"\"\n        event_major = event_version.split(\".\")[0]\n        current_major = cls.CURRENT_VERSION.split(\".\")[0]\n        return event_major == current_major\n    \n    @classmethod\n    def get_migration_notes(cls, from_version: str) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Get migration notes between versions.\"\"\"\n        notes = {}\n        for version, info in cls.SUPPORTED_VERSIONS.items():\n            if version > from_version:\n                notes[version] = info\n        return notes\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. USAGE EXAMPLES\n\n### 7.1 Publishing Events\n\n```python\n# From Docker Event Listener\nawait event_bus.publish(PlatformEvent(\n    event_type=\"container.started\",\n    domain=EventDomain.CONTAINER,\n    source=\"docker-adapter\",\n    service_id=\"osiris-worker-ai\",\n    container_id=\"abc123def456\",\n    severity=EventSeverity.INFO,\n    payload={\n        \"image\": \"osiris/worker-ai:latest\",\n        \"restart_count\": 2,\n        \"previous_lifecycle\": \"stopped\",\n    },\n))\n\n# From Health Monitor\nawait event_bus.publish(PlatformEvent(\n    event_type=\"health.status_changed\",\n    domain=EventDomain.HEALTH,\n    source=\"health-monitor\",\n    service_id=\"osiris-data-postgres\",\n    severity=EventSeverity.WARNING,\n    priority=EventPriority.HIGH,\n    payload={\n        \"old_status\": \"healthy\",\n        \"new_status\": \"unhealthy\",\n        \"health_score\": 42,\n    },\n))\n\n# From Lifecycle Controller\nawait event_bus.publish(PlatformEvent(\n    event_type=\"lifecycle.operation_completed\",\n    domain=EventDomain.LIFECYCLE,\n    source=\"lifecycle-controller\",\n    service_id=\"osiris-worker-ai\",\n    severity=EventSeverity.INFO,\n    payload={\n        \"operation\": \"restart\",\n        \"success\": True,\n        \"duration_ms\": 4500,\n    },\n    correlation_id=\"req_abc123\",\n))\n```\n\n### 7.2 Subscribing to Events\n\n```python\n# Service Registry: listen for all container events\nawait event_bus.subscribe(\n    \"container.*\",\n    handler=registry_updater.handle_container_event,\n    domain_filter={EventDomain.CONTAINER.value},\n)\n\n# Health Scorer: listen for health check results\nawait event_bus.subscribe(\n    \"health.check_*\",\n    handler=health_scorer.process_health_check,\n    domain_filter={EventDomain.HEALTH.value},\n)\n\n# Dependency Engine: listen for service state changes\nawait event_bus.subscribe(\n    \"service.state_changed\",\n    handler=dependency_engine.on_service_change,\n    filter_fn=lambda e: e.payload.get(\"field\") == \"health_state\",\n)\n\n# Alerting: listen for critical events only\nawait event_bus.subscribe(\n    \"*\",\n    handler=alert_engine.process_event,\n    severity_filter={EventSeverity.WARNING.value, EventSeverity.CRITICAL.value},\n    priority=EventPriority.HIGH,\n)\n\n# Specific service monitoring\nawait event_bus.subscribe(\n    \"*\",\n    handler=debug_logger.log_event,\n    service_filter=\"osiris-data-postgres\",\n)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. ### Tour 2020 — Assistant

*2026-06-16 13:16:01 UTC*

Event Bus interne du Control Plane conçu et documenté dans `CONTROL_PLANE_EVENT_BUS.md`.

**Contexte :** Bus distinct des systèmes existants (Redis Streams pour capteurs, Kafka pour domain events). Ce bus interne découple les modules du CP avec latence < 1ms.

**Architecture 3 tiers :**
1. In-process async dispatch (asyncio.Queue) — < 1ms
2. Ring buffer (1000 events) — replay/debug
3. External bridges optionnels (Redis Pub/Sub ~5ms, Kafka ~50ms)

**Event Schema (PlatformEvent envelope) :**
- 14 champs : event_id, schema_version, event_type, domain (8 domains), severity (5 levels), priority (4 niveaux), source, service_id, container_id, timestamp, payload, trace_id, causation_id, correlation_id
- Events immutables (Pydantic frozen=True)
- Hash computation pour déduplication

**30 Event Types definis dans 8 domaines :**
- `container.*` (5 types) — Docker lifecycle
- `service.*` (3 types) — Registry state changes
- `lifecycle.*` (5 types) — Start/stop/restart operations
- `health.*` (6 types) — Health checks, scoring, anomalies, cascade
- `dependency.*` (3 types) — Graph violations
- `config.*` (2 types) — Configuration updates
- `alert.*` (2 types) — Alerting
- `system.*` (2 types) — Internal system events

**Publish/Subscribe Model :**
- Pattern matching avec glob (exact, `container.*`, `*`)
- Filtres multicritères : domain, severity, source, service_id, filter_fn custom
- Priority ordering (CRITICAL=20 > HIGH=10 > NORMAL=5 > LOW=0)
- Error isolation : handler crash ≠ bus crash
- Timeout configurable par handler (défaut 10s)

**External Bridges :**
- RedisBridge — Pub/Sub par domaine, auto-reconnect
- KafkaBridge — Topic `osiris.cp.events`, headers avec event_type/domain/severity

**Failure Handling (7 failure modes) :**
Handler crash isolé, timeout configurable, ring buffer drop oldest, Redis/Kafka graceful disconnect, deduplication, bus shutdown silencieux

**Schema Versioning :** Semver (major.minor.patch), compatibility check, migration notesHAS_CHANGES

MODULE INTEGRATION CODE\n\n### 5.1 Application Factory\n\n```python\n# control-plane/app.py\n\nimport asyncio\nimport logging\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI\n\nfrom .config.loader import PlatformConfig, get_config\nfrom .config.watcher import ConfigWatcher\nfrom .config.broadcaster import ConfigBroadcaster\nfrom .core.event_bus import EventBus\nfrom .core.docker_adapter import DockerAdapter\nfrom .registry.service_registry import ServiceRegistry\nfrom .registry.event_handler import RegistryEventHandler\nfrom .dependencies.engine import DependencyGraphEngine\nfrom .health.scoring_engine import HealthScoringEngine\nfrom .health.anomaly_detector import AnomalyDetector\nfrom .health.alert_engine import AlertEngine\nfrom .lifecycle.controller import LifecycleController\nfrom .events.docker_listener import DockerEventListener\nfrom .events.kafka_bridge import KafkaBridge\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"osiris-cp\")\n\n\nclass ControlPlane:\n    \"\"\"\n    Main application class — owns and wires all modules.\n    \n    Lifecycle:\n        __init__() → configure() → startup() → [running] → shutdown()\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        # Modules (initialized in order)\n        self.config: PlatformConfig = None\n        self.event_bus: EventBus = None\n        self.docker: DockerAdapter = None\n        self.registry: ServiceRegistry = None\n        self.graph: DependencyGraphEngine = None\n        self.health: HealthScoringEngine = None\n        self.anomaly_detector: AnomalyDetector = None\n        self.alert_engine: AlertEngine = None\n        self.lifecycle: LifecycleController = None\n        self.docker_listener: DockerEventListener = None\n        self.config_watcher: ConfigWatcher = None\n        self.config_broadcaster: ConfigBroadcaster = None\n\n    async def startup(self):\n        \"\"\"Initialize and start all modules in dependency order.\"\"\"\n        \n        logger.info(\"═══ Osiris Control Plane starting ═══\")\n        \n        # Phase 1: Foundation (no dependencies)\n        logger.info(\"[1/9] Loading configuration...\")\n        self.config = get_config()\n        \n        logger.info(\"[2/9] Starting Event Bus...\")\n        self.event_bus = EventBus(ring_buffer_size=1000)\n        await self.event_bus.start()\n        \n        # Phase 2: External connections\n        logger.info(\"[3/9] Connecting to Docker Engine...\")\n        self.docker = DockerAdapter()\n        self.docker.connect()\n        \n        # Phase 3: State (depends on Config + Docker)\n        logger.info(\"[4/9] Syncing Service Registry...\")\n        self.registry = ServiceRegistry(self.config, self.event_bus)\n        await self.registry.sync_from_docker(self.docker)\n        \n        # Phase 4: Analysis (depends on Registry)\n        logger.info(\"[5/9] Building Dependency Graph...\")\n        self.graph = DependencyGraphEngine(self.registry, self.config)\n        await self.graph.build_graph()\n        \n        # Phase 5: Health (depends on Registry + Graph + Event Bus)\n        logger.info(\"[6/9] Starting Health Scoring Engine...\")\n        self.health = HealthScoringEngine(self.registry, self.graph, self.event_bus)\n        self.anomaly_detector = AnomalyDetector()\n        self.alert_engine = AlertEngine(self.event_bus)\n        await self.health.start()\n        \n        # Phase 6: Event processing (depends on Registry + Health)\n        logger.info(\"[7/9] Starting Docker Event Listener...\")\n        self.docker_listener = DockerEventListener(\n            docker=self.docker,\n            event_bus=self.event_bus,\n            registry=self.registry,\n            health_scorer=self.health,\n        )\n        await self.docker_listener.start()\n        \n        # Phase 7: Lifecycle (depends on all above)\n        logger.info(\"[8/9] Starting Lifecycle Controller...\")\n        self.lifecycle = LifecycleController(\n            registry=self.registry,\n            event_bus=self.event_bus,\n            dependency_engine=self.graph,\n            docker=self.docker,\n            health_scorer=self.health,\n        )\n        await self.lifecycle.start()\n        \n        # Phase 8: Config hot-reload\n        logger.info(\"[9/9] Starting Config Watcher...\")\n        self.config_watcher = ConfigWatcher(\n            config_path=str(self.config._path),\n            interval=2.0,\n            on_change=self._on_config_change,\n        )\n        self.config_watcher.start()\n        \n        # Optional: Kafka bridge for external event forwarding\n        try:\n            kafka_bridge = KafkaBridge(\n                broker=self.config.raw.get(\"kafka_broker\", \"osiris-infra-kafka:9092\"),\n                topic=\"osiris.cp.events\",\n            )\n            await kafka_bridge.start()\n            self.event_bus.add_bridge(kafka_bridge)\n            logger.info(\"Kafka bridge connected\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.warning(f\"Kafka bridge not available: {e}\")\n        \n        logger.info(\"═══ Osiris Control Plane READY ═══\")\n        logger.info(f\"   Tracking {len(self.registry.get_all_active())} services\")\n        logger.info(f\"   Health: {self.health.get_platform_health().score}/100\")\n        logger.info(f\"   Graph: {len(self.graph.get_snapshot().nodes)} nodes, \"\n                     f\"{len(self.graph.get_snapshot().edges)} edges\")\n\n    async def shutdown(self):\n        \"\"\"Gracefully shutdown all modules in reverse order.\"\"\"\n        \n        logger.info(\"═══ Osiris Control Plane shutting down ═══\")\n        \n        # Reverse startup order\n        if self.config_watcher:\n            self.config_watcher.stop()\n        if self.docker_listener:\n            await self.docker_listener.stop()\n        if self.lifecycle:\n            await self.lifecycle.stop()\n        if self.health:\n            await self.health.stop()\n        if self.docker:\n            self.docker.disconnect()\n        if self.event_bus:\n            await self.event_bus.stop()\n        \n        logger.info(\"═══ Osiris Control Plane stopped ═══\")\n\n    async def _on_config_change(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle config file changes.\"\"\"\n        logger.info(\"Config change detected — reloading...\")\n        self.config.load()\n        \n        # Rebuild dependency graph (deps may have changed)\n        await self.graph.build_graph()\n        \n        # Publish config event\n        from .core.events import PlatformEvent, EventDomain\n        await self.event_bus.publish(PlatformEvent(\n            event_type=\"config.updated\",\n            domain=EventDomain.CONFIG,\n            source=\"config-watcher\",\n            payload={\"config_version\": self.config.version},\n        ))\n```\n\n### 5.2 FastAPI Application\n\n```python\n# control-plane/main.py\n\nimport asyncio\nimport logging\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI\n\nfrom .app import ControlPlane\n\nlogging.basicConfig(\n    level=logging.INFO,\n    format=\"%(asctime)s [%(name)s] %(levelname)s: %(message)s\"\n)\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"osiris-cp\")\n\n# Global control plane instance\ncp = ControlPlane()\n\n@asynccontextmanager\nasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    \"\"\"FastAPI lifespan — startup and shutdown.\"\"\"\n    await cp.startup()\n    yield\n    await cp.shutdown()\n\napp = FastAPI(\n    title=\"Osiris Control Plane\",\n    version=\"1.0.0\",\n    lifespan=lifespan,\n)\n\n# ── API Routes ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n@app.get(\"/health\")\nasync def health():\n    \"\"\"Liveness probe.\"\"\"\n    return {\"status\": \"healthy\", \"module\": \"control-plane\"}\n\n@app.get(\"/ready\")\nasync def readiness():\n    \"\"\"Readiness probe.\"\"\"\n    docker_ok = cp.docker.is_connected() if cp.docker else False\n    registry_ok = len(cp.registry.get_all_active()) > 0 if cp.registry else False\n    \n    ready = docker_ok and registry_ok\n    return {\n        \"status\": \"ready\" if ready else \"not_ready\",\n        \"checks\": {\n            \"docker\": docker_ok,\n            \"registry\": registry_ok,\n        }\n    }\n\n@app.get(\"/api/v1/services\")\nasync def list_services(group=None, health=None, lifecycle=None):\n    \"\"\"List all services.\"\"\"\n    services = cp.registry.get_all_active()\n    if group:\n        services = [s for s in services if s.group_name == group]\n    if health:\n        services = [s for s in services if s.health_state == health]\n    if lifecycle:\n        services = [s for s in services if s.lifecycle_state == lifecycle]\n    return {\"services\": [s.dict() for s in services], \"total\": len(services)}\n\n@app.get(\"/api/v1/services/{name}\")\nasync def get_service(name: str):\n    \"\"\"Get service details.\"\"\"\n    svc = cp.registry.get_service(name)\n    if not svc:\n        return {\"error\": \"not found\"}, 404\n    health_score = cp.health.get_service_score(name)\n    deps = cp.graph.get_snapshot().adjacency.get(name, [])\n    return {\n        **svc.dict(),\n        \"health_score\": health_score.dict() if health_score else None,\n        \"dependencies\": deps,\n    }\n\n@app.post(\"/api/v1/services/{name}/start\")\nasync def start_service(name: str, cascade: bool = True):\n    \"\"\"Start a service.\"\"\"\n    result = await cp.lifecycle.start_service(name, cascade=cascade)\n    return result\n\n@app.post(\"/api/v1/services/{name}/stop\")\nasync def stop_service(name: str, cascade: bool = True):\n    \"\"\"Stop a service.\"\"\"\n    result = await cp.lifecycle.stop_service(name, cascade=cascade)\n    return result\n\n@app.post(\"/api/v1/services/{name}/restart\")\nasync def restart_service(name: str):\n    \"\"\"Restart a service.\"\"\"\n    result = await cp.lifecycle.restart_service(name)\n    return result\n\n@app.get(\"/api/v1/health\")\nasync def platform_health():\n    \"\"\"Platform health summary.\"\"\"\n    return cp.health.get_platform_health().dict()\n\n@app.get(\"/api/v1/graph\")\nasync def dependency_graph(format: str = \"layers\"):\n    \"\"\"Dependency graph.\"\"\"\n    if format == \"layers\":\n        order = await cp.graph.get_startup_order()\n        return order.dict()\n    elif format == \"mermaid\":\n        return {\"diagram\": cp.graph.generate_mermaid()}\n\n@app.get(\"/api/v1/graph/blast/{service_id}\")\nasync def blast_radius(service_id: str):\n    \"\"\"Blast radius analysis.\"\"\"\n    impact = cp.graph.get_impact_score(service_id)\n    impacted = cp.graph.get_blast_radius(service_id)\n    return {\"impact_score\": impact, \"impacted_services\": impacted}\n\n@app.get(\"/api/v1/events\")\nasync def recent_events(service=None, type=None, limit=50):\n    \"\"\"Recent events from ring buffer.\"\"\"\n    events = cp.event_bus.get_recent_events(n=limit, event_type=type, service_id=service)\n    return {\"events\": [e.dict() for e in events], \"total\": len(events)}\n\n@app.get(\"/api/v1/config\")\nasync def get_config():\n    \"\"\"Current platform configuration.\"\"\"\n    return cp.config.raw\n\n# ── Entry Point ─────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import uvicorn\n    uvicorn.run(app, host=\"0.0.0.0\", port=8100)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. DEPLOYMENT MODEL\n\n### 6.1 Phase 1: Single Container\n\n```yaml\n# docker-compose.yml (extrait)\nosiris-gateway-cp:\n  build:\n    context: ./control-plane\n    dockerfile: Dockerfile\n  container_name: osiris-gateway-cp\n  hostname: osiris-gateway-cp\n  volumes:\n    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro\n    - ./config/platform.yaml:/etc/osiris/platform.yaml:ro\n  ports:\n service_healthy\n  networks:\n    - osiris-net-gateway\n    - osiris-net-infra\n    - osiris-net-data\n    - osiris-net-ai\n    - osiris-net-obs\n  deploy:\n    resources:\n      limits:\n 9500     │ Prometheus metrics endpoint (future)             │\n└──────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\nInternal only (not exposed):\n- Docker socket: /var/run/docker.sock\n- FAULT TOLERANCE STRATEGY\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  FAILURE MODE → RECOVERY STRATEGY                                       │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  MODE 1: CP Container Crash                                        │ │\n│  │                                                                     │ │\n│  │  Detection: Docker healthcheck fails (3×10s = 30s)                 │ │\n│  │  Recovery: Docker restarts container (restart: unless-stopped)      │ │\n│  │  Cold start: Full sync from Docker (2s)                            │ │\n│  │  Data loss: None — all state derived from Docker events            │ │\n│  │  State rebuild: Registry sync + graph rebuild + health recompute   │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  MODE 2: Docker Socket Unreachable                                 │ │\n│  │                                                                     │ │\n│  │  Detection: Circuit breaker (5 failures → OPEN)                    │ │\n│  │  Recovery: Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff (max 30s)       │ │\n│  │  Degradation:                                                     │ │\n│  │  ├── Registry serves last-known state (stale but functional)       │ │\n│  │  ├── Health checks stop (scores freeze)                            │ │\n│  │  ├── API continues to serve (with stale data warning headers)      │ │\n│  │  └── Lifecycle operations paused (no Docker access)                │ │\n│  │  On reconnect: Full reconciliation (rebuild from Docker truth)     │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  MODE 3: Event Bus Handler Failure                                 │ │\n│  │                                                                     │ │\n│  │  Detection: Exception in handler coroutine                         │ │\n│  │  Recovery: Error isolation (crash ≠ bus crash)                     │ │\n│  │  Logging: Full context (event_id, handler, exception)              │ │\n│  │  Escalation: N consecutive errors → subscription marked inactive   │ │\n│  │  Impact: Only affected handler stops; others continue              │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  MODE 4: PostgreSQL Unavailable                                    │ │\n│  │ │\n│  │  Degradation:                                                     │ │\n│  │  ├── Events stored in ring buffer only (no persistence)            │ │\n│  │  ├── Service state still tracked in-memory                         │ │\n│  │  └── API continues to function                                     │ │\n│  │  On reconnect: Flush buffered events to DB                         │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  MODE 5: Kafka Unavailable                                         │ │\n│  │                                                                     │ │\n│  │  Detection: Producer delivery report callback                      │ │\n│  │  Recovery: Bridge disconnects gracefully                           │ │\n│  │  Degradation:                                                     │ │\n│  │  ├── In-process dispatch continues unaffected                      │ │\n│  │  ├── External consumers lose events (not critical)                 │ │\n│  │  └── Config propagation pauses (services keep current config)      │ │\n│  │  On reconnect: Bridge resumes, ring buffer replay                  │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  MODE 6: Config File Corrupted                                     │ │\n│  │                                                                     │ │\n│  │  Detection: YAML parse error or Pydantic validation error          │ │\n│  │  Recovery: Keep previous valid config in memory                    │ │\n│  │  Logging: Error + file path + line number                          │ │\n│  │  User action: Fix config file → watcher auto-reloads               │ │\n│  │  No crash: Config system never replaces valid config with invalid  │ │\n│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │  MODE 7: Memory Pressure                                          │ │\n│  │                                                                     │ │\n│  │  Detection: Memory usage > 80% of limit (400MB/512MB)              │ │\n│  │  Recovery:                                                         │ │\n│  │  ├── Ring buffer auto-shrinks (evicts oldest events)               │ │\n│  │  ├── Health history pruned (keep last 100 per service)             │ │\n│  │  ├── Event store rotated (keep last 1000 events) │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. Architecture d'intégration complète du Control Plane conçue et documentée dans `CONTROL_PLANE_INTEGRATION.md`.

**7 modules intégrés avec dependency map :**
Config System → Event Bus → Docker Adapter → Service Registry → Dependency Graph → Health Scoring → Docker Event Listener → Lifecycle Controller → REST API

**Runtime Architecture :**
- Single container Python 3.11 + uvicorn + asyncio
- 3 execution contexts : Main Thread (FastAPI), Async Event Loop, Background Threads
- Shared state : 5 stores in-memory (Registry, Graph, Health, EventBus, Config)
- 3 communication patterns : Event Bus async (< 1ms), Direct calls (< 5ms), Config reference

**Startup Sequence :** 9 étapes séquentielles, ~2s total au cold boot

**Application Factory :** `ControlPlane` class avec startup() et shutdown() ordonnés, FastAPI lifespan, 11 endpoints REST

**Deployment Model :**
- Single container, 512MB memory budget (~170MB utilisé, 340MB headroom)
- Ports : 8100 (API), 9400 (gRPC future), 9500 (metrics future)
- Docker socket en read-only, config YAML monté en volume

**Fault Tolerance (7 failure modes) :**
1. CP Container Crash → Docker auto-restart + cold sync 2s
2. Docker Socket unreachable → Circuit breaker + stale state
3. Event Bus handler failure → Error isolation
4. PostgreSQL unavailable → In-memory fallback
5. Kafka unavailable → Graceful disconnect
6. Config corrupted → Keep previous valid config
7. Memory pressure → Auto-shrink buffers

**Observability :** /health, /ready, /api/v1/system/info, Prometheus metrics

**Evolution Path :** Phase 1 (single container) → Phase 2 (split workers + Redis/PG) → Phase 3 (distributed + etcd/Raft)HAS_CHANGES

## 2. VALIDATION PER CATEGORY

### 2.1 Service State Tracking (70/100)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  CHECK: Service state tracking correctness                              │
│                                                                          │
│  ✅ PASS: State machine clearly defined (7 lifecycle states)            │
│  ✅ PASS: Health state transitions documented                           │
│  ✅ PASS: Timestamps tracked (started_at, last_seen, etc.)              │
│  ✅ PASS: Restart count tracking                                        │
│  ✅ PASS: Docker event → state mapping complete                         │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: No state transition validation (e.g., cannot go              │
│          STOPPED → RUNNING without going through STARTING)              │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: No optimistic locking on state updates (race condition        │
│          if two events arrive for same service simultaneously)          │
│                                                                          │
│  🔴 GAP: In-memory only — state lost on CP restart                      │
│          (mitigated by reconciliation, but initial 2s window is blind)  │
│                                                                          │
│  VERDICT: State model is correct but needs durability and validation.   │
│                                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 2.2 Resilience to Docker Restarts (65/100)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  CHECK: Resilience to Docker daemon restarts                            │
│                                                                          │
│  ✅ PASS: Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff (max 30s)            │
│  ✅ PASS: Circuit breaker prevents thundering herd                      │
│  ✅ PASS: Reconciliation loop detects drift on reconnect                │
│  ✅ PASS: Graceful degradation (stale state served during outage)       │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: Events missed during downtime are NOT replayed                │
│          (Docker event stream has no persistent buffer)                 │
│          Impact: Services that died/restarted during CP downtime        │
│          will show stale state until next reconciliation.               │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: Race condition during reconciliation:                         │
│          If Docker event arrives WHILE reconciliation is running,       │
│          both may try to update the same service record.               │
│                                                                          │
│  🔴 GAP: No health check on Docker socket connectivity                  │
│          (circuit breaker counts failures but doesn't actively probe)   │
│                                                                          │
│  VERDICT: Acceptable for v1 but missed events during downtime is        │
│           a real operational risk in production.                         │
│                                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 2.3 Dependency Graph Accuracy (75/100)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  CHECK: Dependency graph correctness and freshness                      │
│                                                                          │
│  ✅ PASS: Topological sort algorithm correct (Kahn's BFS)              │
│  ✅ PASS: Cycle detection implemented (DFS with back-edge)              │
│  ✅ PASS: Blast radius computation correct (BFS on reverse edges)      │
│  ✅ PASS: Critical path analysis implemented                            │
│  ✅ PASS: Impact scoring with 4 weighted factors                        │
│  ✅ PASS: Graph rebuild on config change and service registration      │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: Graph built from config + Docker labels only                  │
│          (no runtime dependency inference — e.g., actual TCP             │
│          connections between services are not detected)                 │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: Dependency weights are static (defined in config)             │
│          No dynamic adjustment based on observed failure patterns       │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: Graph rebuild is synchronous (blocks other operations        │
│          during rebuild — though O(V+E) < 1ms is fast)                 │
│                                                                          │
│  VERDICT: Algorithms are correct. Runtime inference would improve       │
│           accuracy but is a v2 feature.                                 │
│                                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 2.4 Registry Consistency (55/100)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  CHECK: Registry data consistency and durability                        │
│                                                                          │
│  ✅ PASS: PostgreSQL schema well-designed (5 tables, proper indexes)   │
│  ✅ PASS: UPSERT semantics for event-driven updates                     │
│  ✅ PASS: Reconciliation loop ensures eventual consistency             │
│  ✅ PASS: Event store for audit trail                                   │
│  ✅ PASS: Health check history with time-series partitioning           │
│                                                                          │
│  🔴 CRITICAL: In-memory registry is the PRIMARY store                   │
│          PostgreSQL is described as "optional backing store"            │
│          If CP crashes before DB write, state is lost until             │
│          next reconciliation (up to 30s gap)                            │
│                                                                          │
│  🔴 CRITICAL: No transactional guarantees between registry update       │
│          and event emission (could emit event for stale state)          │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: No read-after-write consistency guarantee across             │
│          multiple API requests (stale cache served for 5s)              │
│                                                                          │
│  ⚠️  GAP: No conflict resolution for concurrent updates                │
│          (two Docker events arriving simultaneously for same service)  │
│                                                                          │
│  VERDICT: Registry design is sound but persistence strategy is         │
│           insufficient for production. PostgreSQL must be PRIMARY,      │
│           not optional.                                                  │
│                                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 4. MISSING COMPONENTS

### 4.1 Critical (Must-Have for v1 Production)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  MISSING #1: Authentication & Authorization                             │
│                                                                          │
│  Impact: API completely open — any network peer can manipulate           │
│          services (start, stop, restart, config changes)                │
│                                                                          │
│  Fix: Implement JWT middleware with role-based access control            │
│       viewer (read) → operator (lifecycle) → admin (config)             │
│                                                                          │
│  Effort: 2-3 days                                                       │
│                                                                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  MISSING #2: Persistent State Store (PostgreSQL as Primary)             │
│                                                                          │
│  Impact: All state lost on CP crash. Reconciliation gap of 30s.         │
│                                                                          │
│  Fix: Make PostgreSQL the primary store, in-memory as cache.            │
│       Write-through on every state change.                              │
│       Read-through with 5s cache TTL.                                   │
│                                                                          │
│  Effort: 3-5 days                                                       │
│                                                                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  MISSING #3: Unit + Integration Test Suite                               │
│                                                                          │
│  Impact: No regression detection. Changes may break existing behavior   │
│          without anyone knowing.                                        │
│                                                                          │
│  Fix: pytest suite with mocks for Docker API.                           │
│       Integration tests using testcontainers (Docker-in-Docker).        │
│       Coverage target: 80% for core modules.                            │
│                                                                          │
│  Effort: 5-7 days                                                       │
│                                                                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  MISSING #4: State Transition Validation                                 │
│                                                                          │
│  Impact: Invalid state transitions possible (e.g., DEAD → RUNNING       │
│          without going through STARTING).                               │
│                                                                          │
│  Fix: Implement state machine guard in Registry update.                 │
│       Reject invalid transitions with logged warning.                   │
│                                                                          │
│  Effort: 1 day                                                          │
│                                                                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  MISSING #5: Concurrency Control on State Updates                       │
│                                                                          │
│  Impact: Two Docker events for same service can race on state update.   │
│                                                                          │
│  Fix: Per-service lock (asyncio.Lock) or optimistic locking             │
│       with version number in PostgreSQL.                                │
│                                                                          │
│  Effort: 1-2 days                                                       │
│                                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

| P2 | Config change diff + approval flow | 3d | Safety |
| P2 | WebSocket upgrade for real-time API | 2d | UX |

### 5.3 Medium-Term (v1.5)

| Priority | Recommendation | Effort | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| P2 | Runtime dependency inference (TCP probe between services) | 5d | Accuracy |
| P2 | Dynamic health weight adjustment based on failure patterns | 3d | Intelligence |
| P2 | Multi-CP-node support (leader election via etcd) | 10d | HA |
| P3 | Plugin system for custom health checks | 5d | Extensibility |
| P3 | Webhook notifications (Slack, PagerDuty) | 2d | Alerting |
| P3 | Config rollback UI | 3d | Ops |

### 5.4 Long-Term (v2.0)

| Priority | Recommendation | Effort | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| P2 | Kubernetes integration (read-only) | 15d | Hybrid |
| P2 | Service mesh integration (Istio/Linkerd) | 20d | Advanced |
| P3 | AI-powered anomaly prediction | 10d | Proactive |
| P3 | Self-healing automation (auto-restart policies) | 5d | Automation |
| P3 | Cost optimization suggestions | 5d | FinOps |

---

## 6. VALIDATION SUMMARY

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                          │
│  PRODUCTION READINESS:  62/100  —  NOT YET PRODUCTION READY             │
│                                                                          │
│  What's good:                                                           │
│  ├── Architecture is clean and well-decomposed (7 modules)             │
│  ├── State machine model is correct and comprehensive                  │
│  ├── Algorithms (topo sort, blast radius, health scoring) are sound    │
│  ├── Event-driven design enables future extensibility                  │
│  ├── Docker resilience (reconnect, reconciliation) is solid            │
│  └── API design is RESTful and well-documented                         │
│                                                                          │
│  What's blocking production:                                            │
│  ├── No authentication (CRITICAL security risk)                        │
│  ├── In-memory only state (CRITICAL durability risk)                   │
│  ├── No test suite (CRITICAL quality risk)                             │
│  └── No state transition validation (HIGH correctness risk)            │
│                                                                          │
│  Time to production-ready:                                              │
│  ├── Minimum (P0 only):  ~1 week                                       │
│  ├── Solid (P0 + P1):    ~2 weeks                                      │
│  └── Confidence (P0-P2): ~1 month                                      │
│                                                                          │
│  Recommendation: Implement P0 items (auth + PG primary + tests),       │
│  then deploy to staging for 1 week of soak testing before production.   │
│                                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

<content># 📊 Osiris Control Dashboard v1 — Frontend Architecture

> Principal Frontend + Platform Architect — Design Document

---

## 1. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

```
 "The dashboard is the single pane of glass for platform operators.
  It must feel alive — every metric updates in real-time,
  every action has immediate visual feedback."
```

| Principle | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **Real-time first** | WebSocket as primary data channel, polling as fallback |
| **Modular panels** | Each section is an independent, composable widget |
| **Scalable** | Virtual scrolling for 100+ services, lazy rendering |
| **Actionable** | Start/stop/restart directly from the UI |
| **Observable** | Health scores, blast radius, dependency graph visualized |
| **Responsive** | Works on desktop (primary) and tablet (secondary) |

---

## 2. FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE

### 2.1 Technology Stack

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  FRONTEND STACK                                                         │
│                                                                          │
│  Framework:     Next.js 15 (React 19) + TypeScript                      │
│  State:         Zustand (lightweight) + React Query (server state)       │
│  Styling:       Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui (component library)            │
│  Real-time:     Socket.IO client (WebSocket with fallback)              │
│  Graph:         D3.js force-directed + React Flow (node-based)          │
│  Charts:        Recharts (lightweight) or Grafana UI embed              │
│  Tables:        TanStack Table (virtualized for 100+ rows)              │
│  Layout:        React Grid Layout (drag-and-drop panels)                │
│  Testing:       Vitest + Playwright (E2E)                               │
│  Build:         Turbopack (fast dev), webpack (production)              │
│                                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 2.2 Project Structure

```
src/
├── app/
│   ├── layout.tsx              # Root layout (sidebar + header)
│   ├── page.tsx                # Dashboard home (overview grid)
│   ├── services/
│   │   └── page.tsx            # Service list (table + filters)
│   ├── services/[name]/
│   │   └── page.tsx            # Service detail view
│   ├── graph/
│   │   └── page.tsx            # Dependency graph (full page)
│   ├── health/
│   │   └── page.tsx            # Health dashboard (scores + alerts)
│   ├── events/
│   │   └── page.tsx            # Event stream (live feed)
│   ├── config/
│   │   └── page.tsx            # Configuration editor
│   └── settings/
│       └── page.tsx            # Dashboard settings
│
├── components/
│   ├── layout/
│   │   ├── Sidebar.tsx         # Navigation sidebar
│   │   ├── Header.tsx          # Top bar (status, alerts, user)
│   │   └── StatusBar.tsx       # Bottom bar (connection, version)
│   ├── dashboard/
│   │   ├── OverviewGrid.tsx    # Main dashboard grid
│   │   ├── PlatformScore.tsx   # Big platform health score
│   │   ├── ServiceCard.tsx     # Compact service status card
│   │   └── AlertTicker.tsx     # Live alert feed
│   ├── services/
│   │   ├── ServiceTable.tsx    # Virtualized service list
│   │   ├── ServiceDetail.tsx   # Full service view
│   │   ├── LifecycleControls.tsx # Start/Stop/Restart buttons
│   │   ├── HealthHistory.tsx   # Health score time series chart
│   │   └── DependencyList.tsx  # Upstream/downstream dependencies
│   ├── graph/
│   │   ├── DependencyGraph.tsx # D3/React Flow graph component
│   │   ├── GraphControls.tsx   # Zoom, filter, layout controls
│   │   ├── NodeTooltip.tsx     # Service node tooltip
│   │   └── BlastRadiusOverlay.tsx # Impact visualization
│   ├── health/
│   │   ├── HealthScoreRing.tsx # Circular score indicator
│   │   ├── HealthTimeline.tsx  # Score over time
│   │   ├── AnomalyList.tsx     # Detected anomalies
│   │   └── SLIBudgetBar.tsx    # Error budget remaining
│   ├── events/
│   │   ├── EventFeed.tsx       # Live event stream (SSE/WebSocket)
│   │   ├── EventCard.tsx       # Individual event display
│   │   └── EventFilters.tsx    # Filter by type, severity, service
│   ├── config/
│   │   ├── ConfigEditor.tsx    # YAML editor with validation
│   │   ├── FeatureFlags.tsx    # Feature flag toggles
│   │   └── VersionHistory.tsx  # Config version timeline
```

## 3. DATA FLOW

### 3.1 Real-Time Data Pipeline

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                          │
│  Control Plane (:8100)              Dashboard (:3000)                    │
│                                                                          │
│  ┌──────────────┐                 ┌──────────────────┐                  │
│  │ REST API     │──── HTTP ────►  │ React Query      │                  │
│  │ /api/v1/*    │   (initial      │ (polling cache)  │                  │
│  └──────────────┘    load)        └────────┬─────────┘                  │
│                                            │                            │
│  ┌──────────────┐                 ┌────────▼─────────┐                  │
│  │ WebSocket    │──── WS ───────► │ useWebSocket     │                  │
│  │ /ws/events   │   (real-time)   │ hook             │                  │
│  └──────────────┘                 └────────┬─────────┘                  │
│                                            │                            │
│                                   ┌────────▼─────────┐                  │
│                                   │ Zustand Store     │                  │
│                                   │ (client state)    │                  │
│                                   └────────┬─────────┘                  │
│                                            │                            │
│                              ┌─────────────┼─────────────┐              │
│                              ▼             ▼             ▼              │
│                       ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐           │
│                       │ Service  │ │ Health   │ │ Event    │           │
│                       │ Table    │ │ Dashboard│ │ Feed     │           │
│                       └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘           │
│                                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 3.2 WebSocket Message Protocol

```typescript
// Server → Client messages
interface WSServerMessage {
  type: 'event' | 'state_update' | 'health_update' | 'config_update' | 'pong';
  data: any;
  timestamp: string;
}

// Client → Server messages
interface WSClientMessage {
  type: 'subscribe' | 'unsubscribe' | 'ping';
  filter?: {
    event_types?: string[];
    service_ids?: string[];
    severities?: string[];
  };
}

// Message flow:
// 1. Client connects → WS /ws/events
// 2. Client subscribes → { type: "subscribe", filter: { event_types: ["container.*", "health.*"] } }
// 3. Server streams events → { type: "event", data: { event_type: "container.started", ... } }
// 4. Server pushes state updates → { type: "state_update", data: { service_id: "...", ... } }
// 5. Heartbeat → { type: "ping" } → { type: "pong" }
```

### 3.3 React Query Cache Strategy

```typescript
// Service list: refetch every 30s (fallback if WS drops)
const servicesQuery = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['services'],
  queryFn: () => api.get('/api/v1/services'),
  refetchInterval: 30_000,  // 30s polling fallback
  staleTime: 5_000,         // 5s before refetch
});

// Single service: refetch every 10s
const serviceQuery = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['service', name],
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/v1/services/${name}`),
  refetchInterval: 10_000,
});

// Health scores: refetch every 15s
const healthQuery = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['health'],
  queryFn: () => api.get('/api/v1/health'),
  refetchInterval: 15_000,
});

// Graph: refetch on demand only
const graphQuery = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['graph'],
  queryFn: () => api.get('/api/v1/graph'),
  staleTime: Infinity,  // Only refetch manually
});
```

## 5. BACKEND API NEEDS

### 5.1 Endpoints Required by Dashboard

| Endpoint | Method | Used By | Polling Interval |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/v1/services` | GET | Service table, overview | 30s |
| `/api/v1/services/{name}` | GET | Service detail | 10s |
| `/api/v1/services/{name}/start` | POST | Lifecycle controls | on-demand |
| `/api/v1/services/{name}/stop` | POST | Lifecycle controls | on-demand |
| `/api/v1/services/{name}/restart` | POST | Lifecycle controls | on-demand |
| `/api/v1/health` | GET | Platform overview, SLI bar | 15s |
| `/api/v1/health/{name}` | GET | Service detail | 10s |
| `/api/v1/graph` | GET | Dependency graph | on-demand |
| `/api/v1/graph/blast/{id}` | GET | Blast radius panel | on-demand |
| `/api/v1/events` | GET | Event feed (initial load) | on-demand |
| `/api/v1/events/stream` | GET(SSE) | Event feed (live) | — |
| `/api/v1/ws/events` | WS | Real-time updates | — |
| `/api/v1/config` | GET | Config page | 60s |
| `/api/v1/config/features` | GET | Feature flags | 60s |
| `/api/v1/config/features/{name}` | PUT | Feature flag toggle | on-demand |

### 5.2 Additional Endpoints Needed (Not Yet in API Spec)

```yaml
# Dashboard-specific endpoints (add to CONTROL_PLANE_API.md)

GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary
  # Aggregated overview data (single request for home dashboard)
  response:
    platform_score: 87
    platform_status: "healthy"
    services_total: 25
    services_healthy: 22
    services_degraded: 2
    services_unhealthy: 1
    alerts_active: 1
    error_budget_remaining: 0.20
    last_event: { ... }
    recent_alerts: [ ... ]

GET /api/v1/events/stream
  # Server-Sent Events endpoint for live event feed
  response: text/event-stream

GET /api/v1/services/{name}/events
  # Event history for a specific service (for detail view timeline)
  query: limit=50, since=ISO8601

GET /api/v1/services/{name}/health/history
  # Health score history for charting
  query: minutes=60 (last N minutes)
  response:
    data_points: [{ timestamp, score, status }]
```

## 6. COMPONENT SPECIFICATIONS

### 6.1 Health Score Ring

```typescript
// Circular gauge showing health score 0-100
// Color: green (≥80) / yellow (50-79) / orange (20-49) / red (<20)
// SVG-based, animated on value change

interface HealthScoreRingProps {
  score: number;        // 0-100
  size?: number;        // px (default: 120)
  strokeWidth?: number; // default: 8
  showLabel?: boolean;  // show score text in center
  animated?: boolean;   // animate on mount
}
```

### 6.2 Service Card

```typescript
// Compact card for dashboard grid
// Shows: name, group, status badge, mini score bar

interface ServiceCardProps {
  service_id: string;
  group: string;
  lifecycle: string;
  health: string;
  health_score: number;
  last_seen: string;
  onClick?: () => void;  // navigate to detail
}
```

### 6.3 Dependency Graph Node

```typescript
// React Flow node for service in dependency graph
// Color-coded by health status
// Shows: name, score, group icon

interface GraphNodeProps {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  group: string;
  health_score: number;
  health_status: string;
  is_hub_node: boolean;  // larger node if true
  impact_score?: number;
  onClick?: () => void;
}
```

### 6.4 Event Feed Item

```typescript
// Single event in live feed
// Color-coded by severity
// Shows: timestamp, type, service, detail, expandable payload

interface EventFeedItemProps {
  event_id: string;
  event_type: string;
  service_id: string;
  severity: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'critical';
  timestamp: string;
  payload: Record<string, any>;
  expanded?: boolean;
}
```

---
