to WebSocket clients.\n    Handles buffering, filtering, and backpressure.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, max_buffer_per_service=5000, batch_interval_ms=500):\n        self._buffers: Dict[str, deque] = defaultdict(\n            lambda: deque(maxlen=max_buffer_per_service)\n        )\n        self._clients: Dict[str, Set[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(set)\n        self._filters: Dict[WebSocket, LogFilter] = {}\n        self._batch_interval = batch_interval_ms / 1000\n        self._sequence = 0\n\n    async def push_log(self, service_id: str, entry: LogEntry):\n        \"\"\"Called by Log Collector for every new log line.\"\"\"\n        self._sequence += 1\n        entry.sequence = self._sequence\n\n        # Store in ring buffer\n        self._buffers[service_id].append(entry)\n\n        # Fan out to subscribed clients\n        for ws in self._clients.get(service_id, set()):\n            filt = self._filters.get(ws)\n            if filt and filt.matches(entry):\n                await self._send_log(ws, entry)\n\n    async def handle_subscribe(self, ws: WebSocket, params: dict):\n        service = params[\"service\"]\n        self._clients[service].add(ws)\n        self._filters[ws] = LogFilter(\n            level=params.get(\"level\", \"debug\"),\n            search=params.get(\"search\"),\n        )\n\n        # Send historical tail\n        tail_n = min(params.get(\"tail\", 100), 5000)\n        tail_lines = list(self._buffers[service])[-tail_n:]\n        filtered = [l for l in tail_lines if self._filters[ws].matches(l)]\n        await ws.send_json({\"type\": \"tail\", \"data\": {\"lines\": [l.dict() for l in filtered], \"count\": len(filtered)}})\n\n    async def handle_filter_update(self, ws: WebSocket, filter_data: dict):\n        if ws in self._filters:\n            self._filters[ws] = LogFilter(\n                level=filter_data.get(\"level\", \"debug\"),\n                search=filter_data.get(\"search\"),\n            )\n\n    async def handle_history_request(self, ws: WebSocket, history_params: dict):\n        \"\"\"Fetch historical logs from Loki.\"\"\"\n        service = self._filters.get(ws, LogFilter()).service or history_params.get(\"service\")\n        # Query Loki for historical data\n        logs = await self._query_loki(\n            service=service,\n            since=history_params[\"since\"],\n            until=history_params[\"until\"],\n            level=history_params.get(\"level\"),\n            search=history_params.get(\"search\"),\n            limit=history_params.get(\"limit\", 500),\n        )\n        await ws.send_json({\"type\": \"history\", \"data\": {\"lines\": [l.dict() for l in logs]}})\n\n    def unsubscribe(self, ws: WebSocket):\n        for service_id, clients in self._clients.items():\n            clients.discard(ws)\n        self._filters.pop(ws, None)\n\n\nclass LogFilter:\n    \"\"\"Client-side log filter.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, level=\"debug\", search=None, service=None):\n        self.level = level\n        self.search = search.lower() if search else None\n        self.service = service\n        self._level_order = {\"debug\": 0, \"info\": 1, \"warning\": 2, \"error\": 3, \"fatal\": 4}\n\n    def matches(self, entry: LogEntry) -> bool:\n        # Level filter\n        min_level = self._level_order.get(self.level, 0)\n        entry_level = self._level_order.get(entry.level, 0)\n        if entry_level < min_level:\n            return False\n\n        # Search filter\n        if self.search:\n            if self.search not in entry.message.lower():\n                if not entry.fields or self.search not in str(entry.fields).lower():\n                    return False\n\n        return True\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. FILTERING STRATEGY\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  FILTER LAYERS                                                          │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Layer 1: SOURCE FILTER (at collector)                                  │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │ - Only collect logs from tracked services (osiris-*)            │   │\n│  │ - Skip Docker system container logs                              │   │\n│  │ - Reduce collection volume by 90%+                              │   │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Layer 2: BUFFER FILTER (at processor)                                  │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │ - All logs stored in per-service ring buffer                    │   │\n│  │ - No filtering here (store everything for history)              │   │\n│  │ - Level detection ensures consistent log levels                  │   │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Layer 3: SUBSCRIPTION FILTER (at WebSocket)                            │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │ Per-client filters:                                              │   │\n│  │   - service_id: exact match                                      │   │\n│  │   - level: minimum threshold (debug < info < warning < error)   │   │\n│  │   - search: substring match on message + fields                 │   │\n│  │   - time range: since/until (for historical)                    │   │\n│  │                                                                    │   │\n│  │ Filter execution:                                                │   │\n│  │   Fast path: level check first (integer comparison)             │   │\n│  │   Slow path: search check only if level passes                  │   │\n│  │   Average: ~0.01ms per log line per client                      │   │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Layer 4: CLIENT FILTER (at browser)                                    │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │ - Additional client-side filtering (for responsiveness)         │   │\n│  │ - Highlight search matches in rendered text                     │   │\n│  │ - Virtual scroll only renders visible lines                     │   │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │\n│                                                                          │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. LOKI INTEGRATION\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  LOKI INTEGRATION (Optional, enhances log system)                       │\n│                                                                          │\n│  WRITE PATH (Push to Loki):                                            │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │ Log Processor batches logs every 1 second (or 100 lines)       │   │\n│  │ Push to Loki via POST /loki/api/v1/push                          │   │\n│  │ Labels: { service, level, container, group }                     │   │\n│  │                                                                    │   │\n│  │ Stream name format:                                              │   │\n│  │   {service=\"osiris-worker-ai\", level=\"error\", group=\"worker\"}   │   │\n│  │                                                                    │   │\n│  │ On push failure:                                                  │   │\n│  │   - Buffer locally (max 10000 lines)                            │   │\n│  │   - Retry with exponential backoff                              │   │\n│  │   - Alert if buffer > 80% full                                  │   │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │\n│                                                                          │\n│  READ PATH (Query from Loki):                                          │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │ Used for:                                                        │   │\n│  │   1. Historical log query (before client connected)             │   │\n│  │   2. Search across large time ranges                            │   │\n│  │   3. Log aggregation (counts, rates)                            │   │\n│  │                                                                    │   │\n│  │ Query format (LogQL):                                            │   │\n│  │   {service=\"osiris-worker-ai\"} |= \"timeout\"                     │   │\n│  │   {service=~\"osiris-worker.*\", level=\"error\"}                    │   │\n│  │                                                                    │   │\n│  │ Response format:                                                 │   │\n│  │   { values: [[timestamp_ns, line], ...], direction: \"forward\" } │   │\n│  │                                                                    │   │\n│  │ Performance:                                                     │   │\n│  │   - Last 1 hour: < 100ms (hot data)                             │   │\n│  │   - Last 24 hours: < 500ms (warm data)                          │   │\n│  │   - Last 7 days: < 2s (cold data)                               │   │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │\n│                                                                          │\n│  LOKI ABSENCE FALLBACK:                                                │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │ If Loki is not available:                                       │   │\n│  │   - Docker logs only (no historical beyond buffer)              │   │\n│  │   - Buffer serves as in-memory \"mini-Loki\" (5000 lines/service)│   │\n│  │   - Search limited to buffer contents                           │   │\n│  │   - Warning: \"Loki not available — limited history\"            │   │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │\n│                                                                          │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. PERFORMANCE CONSTRAINTS\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  PERFORMANCE TARGETS AND CONSTRAINTS                                    │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌────────────────────────┬───────────┬───────────────────────────────┐ │\n│  │ Metric                 │ Target    │ Notes                         │ │\n│  ├────────────────────────┼───────────┼───────────────────────────────┤ │\n│  │ Log ingestion rate     │ 5000/sec  │ Across all services           │ │\n│  │ Per-service rate       │ 500/sec   │ Normal app logging            │ │\n│  │ Parse latency (per line)│ < 0.1ms  │ Simple text, no regex         │ │\n│  │ Filter latency (per line)│ < 0.01ms│ Level check (integer compare)│ │\n│  │ WebSocket delivery     │ < 200ms  │ From log line → browser       │ │\n│  │ Historical query (1h)  │ < 100ms  │ From ring buffer (hot)        │ │\n│  │ Historical query (24h) │ < 500ms  │ From Loki (warm)              │ │\n│  │ Search (buffer)        │ < 10ms   │ Scan 5000 lines               │ │\n│  │ Search (Loki)          │ < 2s     │ Full-text index               │ │\n│  │ Buffer per service     │ 5000     │ Configurable                  │ │\n│  │ Total buffer memory    │ < 125MB  │ 25 services × 5000 lines     │ │\n│  │ WebSocket frame size   │ < 64KB   │ Batch if needed               │ │\n│  │ Max concurrent clients │ 100      │ One WS per browser tab        │ │\n│  │ Loki push batch size   │ 100      │ Or 1 second, whichever first  │ │\n│  └────────────────────────┴───────────┴───────────────────────────────┘ │\n│                                                                          │\n│  BACKPRESSURE:                                                          │\n│  - Per-service buffer ring: 5000 lines (FIFO eviction)                 │\n│  - Per-client outbound: max 100 messages queued                        │\n│  - If client buffer full: drop oldest non-error lines                  │\n│  - If client buffer overflow 3x: disconnect client                     │\n│  - If total ingestion > 5000/sec: sample at 50% (keep all errors)     │\n│                                                                          │\n│  MEMORY BUDGET:                                                         │\n│  - Ring buffers: 25 services × 5000 lines × ~1KB avg = ~125MB        │\n│  - Per-client state: 100 clients × ~1KB = ~100KB                       │\n│  - Loki push buffer: 10000 lines × ~1KB = ~10MB                       │\n│  - TOTAL: ~135MB (within 512MB container limit)                       │\n│                                                                          │\n│  DOCKER LOGS PERFORMANCE:                                               │\n│  - container.logs() is a streaming HTTP response                       │\n│  - One connection per container (persistent)                           │\n│  - Docker daemon handles log rotation (max-size, max-file)            │\n│  - IMPLEMENTATION CODE\n\n```python\n# control-plane/log_collector.py\n\nclass DockerLogCollector:\n    \"\"\"Collects logs from Docker container logs API.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, docker_client):\n        self._docker = docker_client\n        self._streams: Dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}\n        self._running = False\n\n    async def start(self, services: List[str]):\n        \"\"\"Start log collection for all tracked services.\"\"\"\n        self._running = True\n        for service_id in services:\n            self._streams[service_id] = asyncio.create_task(\n                self._collect_service_logs(service_id)\n            )\n\n    async def _collect_service_logs(self, service_id: str):\n        \"\"\"Stream logs from a single container.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            container = self._docker.containers.get(service_id)\n            log_stream = container.logs(\n                follow=True,\n                stdout=True,\n                stderr=True,\n                timestamps=True,\n                tail=100,  # Last 100 lines on start\n            )\n\n            async for line in log_stream:\n                if not self._running:\n                    break\n\n                entry = parse_log_line(line, service_id, container)\n                await log_stream_manager.push_log(service_id, entry)\n\n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.error(f\"Log collection failed for {service_id}: {e}\")\n            # Reconnect after delay\n            await asyncio.sleep(5)\n            if self._running:\n                asyncio.create_task(self._collect_service_logs(service_id))\n\n    async def stop(self):\n        self._running = False\n        for task in self._streams.values():\n            task.cancel()\n\n\ndef parse_log_line(raw_line: bytes, service_id: str, container) -> LogEntry:\n    \"\"\"Parse a raw Docker log line into a LogEntry.\"\"\"\n    text = raw_line.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\").strip()\n\n    # Docker timestamp prefix: \"2026-06-16T16:00:00.000000000Z \"\n    timestamp = None\n    if text[:4].isdigit() or text[0] == \"2\":\n        parts = text.split(\" \", 1)\n        if len(parts) == 2:\n            timestamp = parse_timestamp(parts[0])\n            text = parts[1]\n\n    # Try JSON parse\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(text)\n        level = detect_level(data)\n        return LogEntry(\n            service_id=service_id,\n            container_id=container.id[:12],\n            container_name=container.name,\n            timestamp=timestamp or datetime.utcnow(),\n            level=level,\n            message=data.get(\"msg\") or data.get(\"message\") or data.get(\"log\") or text,\n            source=\"stdout\",\n            fields=data,\n        )\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        pass\n\n    # Plain text\n    level = detect_level_text(text)\n    return LogEntry(\n        service_id=service_id,\n        container_id=container.id[:12],\n        container_name=container.name,\n        timestamp=timestamp or datetime.utcnow(),\n        level=level,\n        message=text,\n        source=\"stderr\" if level in (\"error\", \"fatal\") else \"stdout\",\n    )\n\n\ndef detect_level(data: dict) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Detect log level from JSON fields.\"\"\"\n    for key in (\"level\", \"severity\", \"log_level\", \"lvl\"):\n        val = str(data.get(key, \"\")).lower()\n        if val in (\"debug\", \"info\", \"warning\", \"warn\", \"error\", \"fatal\"):\n            return \"warning\" if val == \"warn\" else val\n    return \"info\"\n\n\ndef detect_level_text(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Detect log level from plain text patterns.\"\"\"\n    upper = text.upper()\n    if \"FATAL\" in upper or \"PANIC\" in upper:\n        return \"fatal\"\n    if \"ERROR\" in upper or \"ERR]\" in upper or \"ERR:\" in upper:\n        return \"error\"\n    if \"WARN\" in upper or \"WARNING\" in upper:\n        return \"warning\"\n    if \"DEBUG\" in upper or \"DBG\" in upper:\n        return \"debug\"\n    return \"info\"\n```\n\n---\n\n*This document defines the Real-Time Log Streaming System. Système de streaming de logs temps réel conçu et documenté dans `LOG_STREAMING_SYSTEM.md`.

**Architecture Pipeline 3 couches :**
1. Log Collector (Docker logs streaming + Loki query)
2. Log Processor (Parse → Normalize → Enrich → Buffer ring 5000 lines/service)
3. WebSocket Streaming (LogStreamManager → WS Hub → per-client fanout)

**LogEntry model :** 13 champs (identity, source, content, parsed fields, metadata, display state)

**Log Processor 4 étapes :**
- Parse : JSON ou plain text avec extraction timestamp Docker
- Normalize : Détection level (6 patterns), timestamp ISO 8601, truncation 10KB
- Enrich : Ajout service_id, container_id, log_id, sequence, stack trace extraction
- Buffer : Ring buffer 5000 lines/service + push async vers Loki

**WebSocket Streaming :**
- Connection : WS /ws/logs?service={id}&level={level}&tail={n}
- 4 message types server→client : tail (historical), log (single line), batch (multiple), stats
- 3 message types client→server : filter (update), history (Loki query), ping
- Per-client filters : level threshold + substring search + time range
- Reconnect auto avec tail history

**Filtrage 4 couches :**
1. Source filter (osiris-* only, 90% volume reduction)
2. Buffer filter (store everything, no filter)
3. Subscription filter (level integer compare + search substring, ~0.01ms/line)
4. Client filter (React virtual scroll, highlight)

**Loki Integration :**
- Write path : batch 100 lines/1s → POST /loki/api/v1/push avec labels
- Read path : LogQL queries, <100ms (1h), <500ms (24h), <2s (7d)
- Fallback si Loki absent : ring buffer = mini-Loki

**Performance :** 5000 logs/sec ingestion, <0.1ms parse, <0.01ms filter, <200ms delivery, ~135MB memory total, 100 clients maxHAS_CHANGES

        │\n│       │                                                                  │\n│       └── WebSocket ─────────────► useWebSocket Hook                   │\n│           WS /ws/events           │                                     │\n│                                   ├─ service_* ──► React Query.invalidate()│\n│                                   ├─ health_*  ──► React               └─ platform_*─► updatePlatformScore()   │\n│                                                    │                     │\n│                                    ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐     │\n│                                    ▼               ▼               ▼     │\n│                              dashboardStore   logStore    React Query  │\n│ ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│                              │        React Components              │   │\n│                              │                                      │   │\n│                                                                       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 3.2 React Query Integration with WebSocket\n\n```typescript\n// hooks/useWebSocket.ts\n\nexport function useWebSocket() {\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n  const { addToast } = useNotificationStore();\n  const { updatePlatformScore } = useDashboardStore();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const ws = new WebSocket(`${WS_URL}/ws/events`);\n\n    ws.onmessage = (msg) => {\n      const event = JSON.parse(msg.data);\n\n      switch (event.type) {\n        // Server state changes → invalidate React Query cache\n        case 'service_update':\n          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['services'] });\n          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['service', event.data.service_id] });\n          break;\n\n        case 'health_update':\n          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['health'] });\n          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['service', event.data.service_id] });\n          break;\n\n        case 'platform_update':\n          updatePlatformScore(event.data.score);\n          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['metrics'] });\n          break;\n\n        // Real-time streams → update Zustand stores directly\n        case 'log':\n          useLogStore.getState().pushLine(event.data);\n          break;\n\n        case 'alert':\n          addToast({\n            severity: event.data.severity,\n            message: event.data.message,\n            service: event.data.service_id,\n          });\n          break;\n      }\n    };\n\n    return () => ws.close();\n  }, [queryClient]);\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. │\n│                                                                          │\n│  T+10ms   Dashboard Realtime Engine receives event                      │\n│           Routes: health.status_changed → service_health_changed        │\n│           Batching window: accumulates                                  │\n│                                                                          │\n│  T+110ms │\n│           queryClient.invalidateQueries(['service', 'osiris-data-clickhouse'])│\n│           queryClient.invalidateQueries(['health'])                    │\n│           queryClient.invalidateQueries(['metrics'])                   │\n│                                                                          │\n│  T+130ms  React Query refetches stale queries:  T+200ms  REST responses arrive, React Query updates cache             │\n│           Components re-render with new data:                           │\n│           - ServiceTable: score bar shrinks, color changes             │\n│           - HealthPage: score ring animates                            │\n│           - Dashboard: platform score recalculates                     │\n│           - Alert badge increments (critical threshold crossed)        │\n│                                                                          │\n│  T+220ms  Additional derived event arrives: alert_fired │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 4.2 Event → Component KEY HOOKS IMPLEMENTATION\n\n```typescript\n// hooks/useServices.ts\nexport function useServices(filters?: ServiceFilters) {\n  return useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['services', filters],\n    queryFn: () () => api.get(`/api/services/${name}`),\n    refetchInterval: 10_000,\n    staleTime: 5_000,\n    enabled: !!name,\n  });\n}\n\n// hooks/useHealth.ts\nexport function useHealth() {\n  return useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['health'],\n    queryFn: () => api.get('/api/health/global'),\n    refetchInterval: 15_000,\n    staleTime: 5_000,\n  });\n}\n\n// hooks/useDependencyGraph.ts\nexport function useDependencyGraph(format = 'full') {\n  return useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['graph', format],\n    queryFn: () => api.get('/api/graph', { params: { format } }),\n    staleTime: Infinity, // Manual refresh only\n  });\n}\n\n// hooks/useEventStream.ts\nexport function useEventStream(filter?: EventFilter) {\n  const [events, setEvents] = useState<Event[]>([]);\n  const ws = useWebSocket();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (ws.connected) {\n      ws.subscribe('events', filter);\n      ws.on('event', (event) => {\n        setEvents(prev => [event, ...prev].slice(0, 500));\n      });\n    }\n    return () => ws.unsubscribe('events');\n  }, [ws.connected, filter]);\n\n  return { events, isConnected: ws.connected };\n}\n\n// hooks/useLogStream.ts\nexport function useLogStream(serviceId: string, options?: LogStreamOptions) {\n  const { pushLine, stats } = useLogStore();\n  const ws = useWebSocket();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (ws.connected && serviceId) {\n      ws.subscribe('logs', { service: serviceId, ...options });\n      ws.on('log', (line) => pushLine(line));\n      ws.on('batch', (batch) => batch.lines.forEach(pushLine));\n      ws.on('stats', (s) => useLogStore.getState().updateStats(s));\n    }\n    return () => ws.unsubscribe('logs');\n  }, [ws.connected, serviceId]);\n\n  return { lines: useLogStore(s => s.lines), stats };\n}\n\n// hooks/useLifecycleAction.ts\nexport function useLifecycleAction() {\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n  const addToast = useNotificationStore(s => s.addToast);\n\n  const mutate = useMutation({\n    mutationFn: ({ serviceId, action }: { serviceId: string; action: 'start' | 'stop' | 'restart' }) =>\n      api.post(`/api/services/${serviceId}/${action}`),\n    onSuccess: (data, variables) => {\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['services'] });\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['service', variables.serviceId] });\n      addToast({\n        severity: 'info',\n        message: `Service ${variables.action} successful`,\n        service: variables.serviceId,\n      });\n    },\n    onError: (error, variables) => {\n      addToast({\n        severity: 'error',\n        message: `Failed to ${variables.action} ${variables.serviceId}`,\n        service: variables.serviceId,\n      });\n    },\n  });\n\n  return {\n    start: (id: string) => mutate.mutate({ serviceId: id, action: 'start' }),\n    stop: (id: string) => mutate.mutate({ serviceId: id, action: 'stop' }),\n    restart: (id: string) => mutate.mutate({ serviceId: id, action: 'restart' }),\n    isLoading: mutate.isPending,\n  };\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Flow\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  SIMPLIFIED FLOW (stop is faster than start):                           │\n│                                                                          │\n│  1. Browser: POST /api/v1/services/{name}/stop                         │\n│  2. CP: LifecycleController.stop_service()                             │\n│     a. DockerAdapter.stop_container()                                  │\n│  3. Docker: container.stop(timeout=30)                                │\n│  4. Docker emits: container.die event                                  │\n│  5. CP: Registry update: lifecycle → \"stopped\"                        │\n│  6. CP: Event Bus → Dashboard: service_stopped                        │\n│  7. Dashboard: UI updates (row dimmed, buttons swap, event feed)      │\n│                                                                          │\n│  TOTAL: ~31s (HTTP 100ms + Docker stop 30s + propagation 500ms)       │\n│                                                                          │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. FAILURE HANDLING STRATEGY\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                                                                          │\n│  FAILURE Sequence\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                                                                          │\n│  CONTROL PLANE CRASH attempts (fails)                      │\n│           Dashboard: Shows last-known state (stale)                     │\n│                                                                          │\n│  T+30s    Docker restarts CP container (restart: unless-stopped)       │\n│                                                                          │\n│  T+32s    CP starts up: \"3000:3000\"\n    environment:\n      NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: http://osiris-gateway-cp:8100\n      NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL: ws://osiris-gateway-cp:8100\n    depends_on:\n      osiris-gateway-cp:\n        condition: service_healthy\n    networks: [osiris-net-gateway]\n    deploy: { resources: { limits: { memory: 256M } } }\n    healthcheck:\n      test: [\"CMD\", \"wget\", \"-qO-\", \"http://localhost:3000\"]\n      interval: 15s\n      timeout: 5s\n      retries: 3\n    restart: unless-stopped\n\n  # ── Nginx (Production proxy) ──────────────────\n  osiris-nginx:\n    image: nginx:alpine\n    container_name: osiris-nginx\n    ports:\n      - osiris-dashboard/

**Backend (FastAPI :8100) :**
- REST API : GET /api/services, GET /api/services/{name}, POST /start|stop|restart, GET /api/metrics, GET /api/graph, GET /api/health/global, GET /api/events
- WebSocket : /ws/events (real-time Docker events broadcast), /ws/logs (live log streaming)
- Docker integration : auto-sync containers, real-time event listener, container lifecycle management
- Health scoring : compute score 0-100 based on container state + health check

**Frontend (React + Vite :3000) :**
- ServiceList : table virtualisée avec filtres, health score bars, boutons Start/Stop/Restart
- HealthHeader : 4 cards métriques (score, healthy, status, count)
- DependencyGraph : visualisation SVG des nœuds et arêtes de dépendances
- LogStream : streaming logs temps réel via WebSocket avec filtres service/level
- MetricsPanel : métriques par groupe avec health bars
- EventFeed : flux d'événements temps réel via WebSocket
- ServiceDetail : vue détaillée d'un service avec actions lifecycle

**Pour lancer :**
```bash
# Option 1: Docker Compose
cd osiris-dashboard && docker-compose up --build

# Option 2: Local dev
# Terminal 1:
cd osiris-dashboard/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && python main.py
# Terminal 2:
cd osiris-dashboard/frontend && npm install && npm run dev
```HAS_CHANGES
